title: Istraživanje: Kafa može promijeniti rad crijeva
Study: Coffee can change how the gut works
body: Naučnici sa Univerziteta u Kopenhagenu istraživali su kako kafa utiče na rad crijeva.
Scientists from the University of Copenhagen researched how coffee affects how the gut works.
U istraživanju je učestvovala 61 zdrava odrasla osoba.
61 healthy adults took part in the study.
Rezultati su objavljeni u naučnom časopisu, a o njima je pisao Euronews.
The results were published in a scientific journal, and Euronews wrote about them.
Pedeset učesnika progutalo je malu elektronsku kapsulu koja je prolazila kroz probavni sistem.
Fifty participants swallowed a small electronic capsule that passed through the digestive system.
Kapsula je mjerila temperaturu, kiselost i pokrete crijeva.
The capsule measured temperature, acidity and the movements of the gut.
Učesnici su podijeljeni u dvije grupe prema tome koliko često piju kafu.
The participants were divided into two groups according to how often they drink coffee.
Prva grupa pila je jednu do pet šoljica dnevno više od tri dana u toku osam dana istraživanja.
The first group drank one to five cups a day on more than three of the eight days of the study.
Kod ljudi koji redovno piju kafu bilo je više različitih vrsta crijevnih bakterija.
In people who regularly drink coffee there were more different kinds of gut bacteria.
Njihovo debelo crijevo češće se stezalo, a u tankom crijevu kiselost je bila veća.
Their large intestine contracted more often, and acidity was higher in the small intestine.
Autori ipak kažu da kafa samo može uticati na probavu, jer istraživanje ne dokazuje uzrok.
The authors nevertheless say that coffee only may affect digestion, because the study does not prove a cause.

title: Pjevačica s Filipina pobijedila na prvom azijskom Eurosongu
A singer from the Philippines won the first Asian Eurovision
body: Filipinska pjevačica Carmelle pobijedila je na prvom azijskom Eurosongu s pjesmom "Sobra-Sobra".
Filipino singer Carmelle won the first Asian Eurovision with the song "Sobra-Sobra".
Finale je održano u subotu u Bangkoku, glavnom gradu Tajlanda.
The final was held on Saturday in Bangkok, the capital of Thailand.
Trofej joj je uručila bugarska pjevačica DARA, koja je pobijedila na ovogodišnjem Eurosongu u Beču.
The trophy was presented to her by Bulgarian singer DARA, who won this year's Eurovision in Vienna.
Carmelle je osvojila 211 bodova i bila je prva i kod žirija i kod publike.
Carmelle won 211 points and was first both with the jury and with the public.
Drugo mjesto zauzeo je tajlandski duo MANG x DAOU sa 170 bodova, a treća je bila Tóc Tiên iz Vijetnama.
Second place went to the Thai duo MANG x DAOU with 170 points, and third was Tóc Tiên from Vietnam.
Na takmičenju je učestvovalo 11 zemalja, a pjesme su se pjevale na deset lokalnih jezika i engleskom.
11 countries took part in the competition, and songs were sung in ten local languages and English.
Prema organizatorima, glasovi su stigli iz 183 zemlje i teritorije.
According to the organisers, votes came from 183 countries and territories.
Carmelle je poznata iz televizijskih takmičenja, a pjesmu pjeva na filipinskom i engleskom.
Carmelle is known from television competitions, and she sings the song in Filipino and English.
Pjesma govori o snazi žena na Filipinima.
The song is about the strength of women in the Philippines.
Direktor Eurosonga Martin Green rekao je da je prvo azijsko izdanje veliki korak za takmičenje.
Eurovision director Martin Green said that the first Asian edition is a big step for the competition.

title: Navijači BiH u velikoj koloni krenuli prema stadionu u Solni
BiH fans set off in a big column towards the stadium in Solna
body: Navijači Bosne i Hercegovine u subotu su u velikoj koloni krenuli prema stadionu Strawberry Arena u Solni.
Fans of Bosnia and Herzegovina set off on Saturday in a big column towards the Strawberry Arena stadium in Solna.
Kolonu je predvodila navijačka grupa BH Fanaticosi.
The column was led by the fan group BH Fanaticosi.
Reprezentacija BiH večeras u 20:45 igra protiv Švedske u petom kolu Lige nacija.
The BiH national team plays against Sweden tonight at 20:45 in the fifth round of the Nations League.
Navijači su se cijeli dan okupljali u Stockholmu, a prema stadionu su krenuli u 18:00.
Fans gathered in Stockholm all day, and they set off towards the stadium at 18:00.
Na ulicama grada zapalili su mnogo baklji, pa je atmosfera bila vrlo jaka.
They lit many flares on the city streets, so the atmosphere was very strong.
Grupa je šetnju najavila na Facebooku pod imenom "Operacija Stockholm" i zamolila navijače da dođu u crnom.
The group announced the march on Facebook under the name "Operation Stockholm" and asked fans to come in black.
Prema Nogometnom savezu BiH, sektor F za bh. navijače otvara se u 18:30, sat prije ostatka stadiona.
According to the Football Association of BiH, sector F for BiH fans opens at 18:30, an hour before the rest of the stadium.
Savez je pozvao navijače da dođu ranije, kako ne bi bilo gužve na ulazima.
The association called on fans to come early so that there would be no crowds at the entrances.
BiH je nakon četiri kola druga u grupi s 8 bodova, dva manje od Švedske.
After four rounds, BiH is second in the group with 8 points, two fewer than Sweden.
Ako večeras pobijedi, reprezentacija BiH bi preuzela prvo mjesto.
If it wins tonight, the BiH national team would take over first place.

title: Navijači BiH ispunili metro u Stockholmu pred veliku utakmicu
BiH fans filled the Stockholm metro before the big match
body: Navijači Bosne i Hercegovine u subotu su ispunili metro u Stockholmu.
Fans of Bosnia and Herzegovina filled the metro in Stockholm on Saturday.
Novinari Klixa javljaju da su se u vagonima čule pjesme i vidjele boje BiH.
Klix reporters report that songs were heard and the colours of BiH were seen in the carriages.
Reprezentacija večeras u 20:45 igra protiv Švedske na stadionu u Solni.
The national team plays against Sweden tonight at 20:45 at the stadium in Solna.
Utakmica petog kola grupe B4 odlučuje o prvom mjestu.
The match of the fifth round of group B4 decides first place.
Švedska ima 10 bodova, a BiH 8, pa bi pobjeda Švedske donijela prvo mjesto i ulazak u Ligu A.
Sweden has 10 points and BiH 8, so a Swedish win would bring first place and entry into League A.
Ako pobijedi BiH, pobjednik grupe dobit će se tek u zadnjem kolu.
If BiH wins, the group winner will only be decided in the last round.
Zbog velikog interesa, savez je pustio u prodaju dodatne ulaznice po 30 i 60 eura.
Because of great interest, the association put extra tickets on sale for 30 and 60 euros.
BiH je u ovoj grupi igrala 0:0 u Poljskoj, pobijedila Rumuniju 4:2 i igrala 1:1 sa Švedskom.
In this group BiH drew 0:0 in Poland, beat Romania 4:2 and drew 1:1 with Sweden.
Nakon toga je kod kuće pobijedila Poljsku 1:0.
After that it beat Poland 1:0 at home.
Selektor Sergej Barbarez rekao je da očekuje podršku navijača kao i uvijek, ali da Švedska ima dobru ekipu.
Head coach Sergej Barbarez said that he expects the fans' support as always, but that Sweden has a good team.

title: Sarajevo i Željezničar kažnjeni zbog pirotehnike na derbiju
Sarajevo and Željezničar fined over pyrotechnics at the derby
body: Disciplinska komisija Nogometnog saveza BiH kaznila je FK Sarajevo i FK Željezničar zbog pirotehnike.
The disciplinary committee of the Football Association of BiH fined FK Sarajevo and FK Željezničar over pyrotechnics.
Sarajevo mora platiti 16.500 KM, a Željezničar ukupno 20.000 KM.
Sarajevo must pay 16,500 KM, and Željezničar a total of 20,000 KM.
Kazne su uglavnom zbog gradskog derbija na stadionu Koševo.
The fines are mainly because of the city derby at the Koševo stadium.
Sarajevo je platilo 10.000 KM zbog pirotehnike i 5.000 KM zbog loše organizacije utakmice.
Sarajevo paid 10,000 KM because of pyrotechnics and 5,000 KM because of poor organisation of the match.
Još 1.500 KM klub plaća zbog dronova, lasera i drugih svjetlosnih efekata.
The club pays another 1,500 KM because of drones, lasers and other light effects.
Ako se to ponovi u narednih šest mjeseci, Sarajevo će igrati pred praznim stadionom.
If this happens again in the next six months, Sarajevo will play in front of an empty stadium.
Željezničar je dobio 10.000 KM kazne za derbi i još 10.000 KM za utakmicu protiv Zrinjskog.
Željezničar got a 10,000 KM fine for the derby and another 10,000 KM for the match against Zrinjski.
Željezničar je tu utakmicu kod kuće izgubio 0:4.
Željezničar lost that match at home 0:4.
I njemu prijeti zabrana dolaska navijača na jednu utakmicu ako se prekršaj ponovi.
It is also threatened with a ban on fans attending one match if the offence is repeated.
Kazne su dobili i drugi klubovi, među njima Zrinjski 6.000 KM i Borac 5.500 KM.
Other clubs also got fines, among them Zrinjski 6,000 KM and Borac 5,500 KM.

title: Stručnjaci: Deponija na Ilidži mogla bi godinama zagađivati tlo
Experts: The dump in Ilidža could pollute the soil for years
body: Divlja deponija na Ilidži nalazi se u prvoj zoni zaštite izvorišta vode Sarajevsko polje.
A wild dump in Ilidža is located in the first protection zone of the Sarajevsko polje water source.
Stručnjaci upozoravaju da bi zagađenje tla moglo ostati godinama.
Experts warn that the soil pollution could remain for years.
Otpad se zakopava i pali pored rijeke Željeznice, između Sokolović Kolonije i Hrasnice.
Waste is buried and burned next to the Željeznica river, between Sokolović Kolonija and Hrasnica.
Profesor Haris Kalajdžisalihović rekao je da bi zagađenje iz prve zone brzo moglo doći do bunara.
Professor Haris Kalajdžisalihović said that pollution from the first zone could quickly reach the wells.
Podzemna voda je tu obično 5 do 10 metara ispod površine.
The groundwater there is usually 5 to 10 metres below the surface.
Biolog Admir Aladžuz najviše brine zbog ulja i metala, jer ih kiša može odnijeti u podzemnu vodu.
Biologist Admir Aladžuz is most worried about oils and metals, because rain can carry them into the groundwater.
Zato predlaže da se voda testira na metale i ulja.
That is why he suggests that the water be tested for metals and oils.
Sarajevsko polje snabdijeva vodom više od polovine stanovnika Sarajeva, a grad nema drugi izvor slične veličine.
Sarajevsko polje supplies water to more than half of Sarajevo's residents, and the city has no other source of similar size.
Kalajdžisalihović kaže da treba utvrditi ko je odgovoran, zaustaviti odlaganje otpada i naći novac za čišćenje.
Kalajdžisalihović says it is necessary to establish who is responsible, stop the dumping of waste and find money for the clean-up.
Tužilaštvo Kantona Sarajevo je u julu odlučilo da ne pokrene istragu protiv bivšeg načelnika Ilidže.
The Sarajevo Canton Prosecutor's Office decided in July not to open an investigation against the former mayor of Ilidža.

title: Zastupnik Ćopić napustio SDS i kritikovao Blanušu
MP Ćopić left the SDS and criticised Blanuša
body: Vladimir Ćopić, zastupnik u Narodnoj skupštini Republike Srpske, napustio je SDS i prešao u Ujedinjenu Srpsku.
Vladimir Ćopić, a member of the National Assembly of Republika Srpska, left the SDS and moved to Ujedinjena Srpska.
U prvoj izjavi nakon toga rekao je da je SDS u rasulu, odnosno da se stranka raspada.
In his first statement after that, he said that the SDS is in disarray, that is, that the party is falling apart.
Za to je okrivio lidera stranke Branka Blanušu.
He blamed party leader Branko Blanuša for this.
Ćopić je rekao da Blanuša nema budućnosti ni za SDS ni za Republiku Srpsku.
Ćopić said that Blanuša has no future either for the SDS or for Republika Srpska.
Objasnio je da želi biti dio dvotrećinske većine u skupštini u vremenu velikih izazova.
He explained that he wants to be part of the two-thirds majority in the assembly at a time of big challenges.
Rekao je i da su teški poraz na izborima i afere dodatno podijelili stranku.
He also said that the heavy defeat in the elections and the scandals further divided the party.
Ćopić dolazi iz male općine Kostajnica.
Ćopić comes from the small municipality of Kostajnica.
Tvrdi da su ljudi iz vodstva SDS-a noću došli pred njegovu kuću s televizijskom ekipom.
He claims that people from the SDS leadership came to his house at night with a television crew.
To je nazvao uznemiravanjem porodice i najavio krivične prijave protiv svih koji su bili tamo.
He called this harassment of his family and announced criminal complaints against everyone who was there.
Dodao je da njegov mandat pripada njemu i njegovim biračima.
He added that his mandate belongs to him and his voters.

title: Hrvatski ministar: Nemamo dokaze da je policija tukla migrante
Croatian minister: We have no evidence that police beat migrants
body: Hrvatski ministar unutrašnjih poslova Davor Božinović odgovorio je na optužbe o nasilju nad migrantima na granici s BiH.
Croatian Interior Minister Davor Božinović responded to accusations of violence against migrants on the border with BiH.
Austrijska organizacija SOS Balkanroute tvrdi da je hrvatska policija tukla 53 migranta i vratila ih u BiH.
The Austrian organisation SOS Balkanroute claims that Croatian police beat 53 migrants and returned them to BiH.
Božinović je rekao da hrvatska policija nema informacije koje bi to potvrdile.
Božinović said that Croatian police have no information that would confirm this.
Prema organizaciji, oko 15 policajaca s maskama napalo je migrante u srijedu, 11. novembra.
According to the organisation, about 15 masked police officers attacked the migrants on Wednesday, 11 November.
Pet osoba prevezeno je kolima hitne pomoći sa slomljenim rukama ili nogama i povredama glave.
Five people were taken by ambulance with broken arms or legs and head injuries.
Tim organizacije i Crvenog krsta pronašao je 40 ljudi u selima Tržac, Crnaja i Šturlić.
A team of the organisation and the Red Cross found 40 people in the villages of Tržac, Crnaja and Šturlić.
Među njima su bile tri žene i dvoje maloljetnika.
Among them were three women and two minors.
Ministar je rekao da Hrvatska nije dobila nikakvu službenu informaciju od policije BiH.
The minister said that Croatia had received no official information from the BiH police.
Dodao je da u BiH postoji nasilje kriminalnih grupa među migrantima, ali to ne mora biti povezano s ovim slučajem.
He added that there is violence by criminal groups among migrants in BiH, but this does not have to be connected with this case.
SOS Balkanroute traži nezavisnu istragu o ovom i ranijim slučajevima na granici.
SOS Balkanroute is asking for an independent investigation into this and earlier cases on the border.

title: Voyager 1 uskoro jedan svjetlosni dan daleko od Zemlje
Voyager 1 soon one light-day away from Earth
body: NASA-ina letjelica Voyager 1 u srijedu bi trebala biti jedan svjetlosni dan udaljena od Zemlje.
NASA's spacecraft Voyager 1 should be one light-day away from Earth on Wednesday.
To znači da njenim signalima treba tačno 24 sata da stignu do nas.
This means that its signals need exactly 24 hours to reach us.
Letjelica je lansirana prije 49 godina i sada je oko 26 milijardi kilometara daleko.
The spacecraft was launched 49 years ago and is now about 26 billion kilometres away.
NASA procjenjuje da će joj trebati još oko 18.000 godina do jedne svjetlosne godine.
NASA estimates that it will need about 18,000 more years to reach one light-year.
Voyager 1 i njegov blizanac Voyager 2 putuju brzinom od oko 61.000 kilometara na sat.
Voyager 1 and its twin Voyager 2 travel at a speed of about 61,000 kilometres per hour.
Iako su stare, obje letjelice i danas šalju naučne podatke na Zemlju.
Although they are old, both spacecraft still send scientific data to Earth today.
Voyager 1 je 1979. i 1980. prošao pored Jupitera i Saturna, a u međuzvjezdani prostor ušao je 2012.
Voyager 1 flew past Jupiter and Saturn in 1979 and 1980, and it entered interstellar space in 2012.
Voditeljica projekta Suzanne Dodd rekla je da je letjelica ambasador Zemlje među zvijezdama.
Project manager Suzanne Dodd said that the spacecraft is Earth's ambassador among the stars.
NASA je pozvala ljude da u utorak nakon zalaska sunca pošalju svjetlosni pozdrav telefonom ili baterijom.
NASA invited people to send a light greeting with a phone or a torch on Tuesday after sunset.
Na letjelici je i zlatna ploča s pozdravima na 55 jezika.
On the spacecraft there is also a golden record with greetings in 55 languages.

title: Osumnjičeni za ubistvo na Dolac Malti i otac predati tužilaštvu
Murder suspect from Dolac Malta and his father handed to prosecutors
body: Emil Semir Tahirović (18) i njegov otac danas su predati Tužilaštvu Kantona Sarajevo.
Emil Semir Tahirović (18) and his father were handed over to the Sarajevo Canton Prosecutor's Office today.
Mladić je osumnjičen da je ubio zaštitara Mehmeda Smječanina na Dolac Malti u Sarajevu.
The young man is suspected of killing security guard Mehmed Smječanin at Dolac Malta in Sarajevo.
Ubistvo se dogodilo u noći sa četvrtka na petak, ispred kafića Port 04.
The killing happened on the night from Thursday to Friday, in front of the Port 04 café.
Smječanin je tamo radio kao zaštitar i pokušao je smiriti sukob dvije grupe mladića.
Smječanin worked there as a security guard and tried to calm a fight between two groups of young men.
Prema kafiću, tokom sukoba bacane su stolice, a korišteno je i vatreno oružje.
According to the café, chairs were thrown during the fight, and a firearm was also used.
Tahirović je nakon toga pobjegao, ali ga je policija pronašla i uhapsila u petak.
Tahirović fled after that, but the police found and arrested him on Friday.
Njegov otac je osumnjičen da mu je pomogao nakon djela i da je nezakonito imao oružje.
His father is suspected of helping him after the crime and of illegally owning a weapon.
Tužilaštvo je saopćilo da će oba osumnjičena biti zadržana 24 sata.
The prosecutor's office said that both suspects will be held for 24 hours.
U tom roku tužilac će odlučiti o daljim mjerama.
Within that time the prosecutor will decide on further measures.
Tahirović je državljanin Njemačke, a policija provjerava da li ima i crnogorsko državljanstvo.
Tahirović is a German citizen, and the police are checking whether he also has Montenegrin citizenship.
Pored kafića pronađen je i automobil s crnogorskim tablicama koji je povezan s njim.
A car with Montenegrin plates that is linked to him was also found next to the café.

title: Behija Kulović privremeno vodi Našu stranku
Behija Kulović temporarily leads Naša stranka
body: Glavni odbor Naše stranke izabrao je Behiju Kulović za vršiteljicu dužnosti predsjednice stranke.
The Main Board of Naša stranka elected Behija Kulović as acting president of the party.
Ona će voditi stranku nakon što je dosadašnja predsjednica Sabina Ćudić podnijela ostavku.
She will lead the party after the previous president Sabina Ćudić resigned.
Novi predsjednik ili predsjednica bit će izabrani na kongresu 20. marta naredne godine.
The new president will be elected at a congress on 20 March next year.
Na kongresu će stranka birati i članove Glavnog odbora i tri potpredsjednika.
At the congress the party will also elect members of the Main Board and three vice presidents.
Bit će izabrani i Nadzorni odbor i Etička komisija.
The Supervisory Board and the Ethics Commission will also be elected.
Kulović je po zanimanju prosvjetna radnica, a politikom se počela baviti u Kaknju.
Kulović is a teacher by profession, and she started doing politics in Kakanj.
Od 2022. godine zastupnica je Naše stranke u Skupštini Zeničko-dobojskog kantona.
Since 2022 she has been a Naša stranka member of the Zenica-Doboj Canton Assembly.
Kulović je rekla da stranku čeka period pregrupisavanja, dijaloga i zajedničkog rada.
Kulović said that a period of regrouping, dialogue and joint work awaits the party.
Dodala je da stranka ozbiljno shvata rezultat izbora, ali da ne počinje od nule.
She added that the party takes the election result seriously, but that it is not starting from zero.
Želi jače lokalne organizacije i veću ulogu članova u odlukama.
She wants stronger local organisations and a bigger role for members in decisions.
Rekla je i da je stranka otvorena za nove ljude i ideje.
She also said that the party is open to new people and ideas.

title: Rumunski general: Rusija želi ukrajinske oblasti bez borbe
Romanian general: Russia wants Ukrainian regions without fighting
body: Penzionisani rumunski general Virgil Bălăceanu upozorio je da Rusija želi četiri ukrajinske oblasti preko pregovora.
Retired Romanian general Virgil Bălăceanu warned that Russia wants four Ukrainian regions through negotiations.
On je u petak govorio za televiziju Digi24 o razgovorima Ukrajine, SAD-a i Rusije u Abu Dhabiju.
On Friday he spoke to the TV channel Digi24 about the talks between Ukraine, the USA and Russia in Abu Dhabi.
Prema njegovim riječima, ti razgovori nisu donijeli mnogo novog.
According to him, those talks did not bring much new.
Rusija, kako kaže, želi cijelu Lugansku oblast, gdje Ukrajina drži još samo 0,38 posto teritorije.
Russia, he says, wants the whole Luhansk region, where Ukraine still holds only 0.38 percent of the territory.
Želi i Donjeck, Zaporožje i Herson, gdje Ukrajina kontroliše 31 posto oblasti.
It also wants Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson, where Ukraine controls 31 percent of the region.
Bălăceanu je rekao da bi desna obala Hersona Rusiji bila baza za novi rat.
Bălăceanu said that the right bank of Kherson would be a base for a new war for Russia.
Odatle bi lakše mogla doći do Odese, ušća Dunava i Pridnjestrovlja.
From there it could more easily reach Odesa, the mouth of the Danube and Transnistria.
Pridnjestrovlje je proruska regija u Moldaviji koja ne priznaje vlast u Kišinjevu.
Transnistria is a pro-Russian region in Moldova that does not recognise the government in Chișinău.
Zato je general rekao da Rumunija mora biti veoma oprezna.
That is why the general said that Romania must be very careful.
Dodao je da Rusija želi Ukrajinu bez vojske i bez članstva u NATO-u.
He added that Russia wants Ukraine without an army and without NATO membership.
Kao primjer dobre pripreme naveo je Finsku, koja može mobilizirati skoro 500.000 ljudi.
As an example of good preparation he named Finland, which can mobilise almost 500,000 people.

title: Poznati navijač "Amin dedo" stigao u Stockholm
Famous fan "Amin dedo" arrives in Stockholm
body: Elvedin Šečić, navijač kojeg mnogi znaju kao "Amin dedo", stigao je u Stockholm.
Elvedin Šečić, a fan whom many know as "Amin dedo", has arrived in Stockholm.
On će večeras na tribinama bodriti reprezentaciju BiH protiv Švedske.
Tonight he will cheer for the BiH national team against Sweden from the stands.
Šečić je rodom iz Bugojna, a živi u Norveškoj.
Šečić is originally from Bugojno, and he lives in Norway.
Postao je poznat nakon polufinala doigravanja protiv Walesa.
He became famous after the play-off semi-final against Wales.
Kamere su ga tada snimile dok je prije penala molio za pobjedu.
The cameras then filmed him while he was praying for victory before the penalties.
Nakon toga su mu navijači dali nadimak "Amin dedo".
After that the fans gave him the nickname "Amin dedo".
Reprezentaciju BiH vodi selektor Sergej Barbarez.
The BiH national team is led by head coach Sergej Barbarez.
Šečić je novinarima rekao da nije dobar u prognozama rezultata.
Šečić told journalists that he is not good at predicting results.
Ipak, nada se da reprezentacija ove večeri neće izgubiti.
Still, he hopes that the team will not lose this evening.
Rekao je da bi bio zadovoljan i neriješenim rezultatom, a pobjedom posebno.
He said he would be happy with a draw too, and especially with a win.
Na pitanje ko bi mogao dati gol, odgovorio je da to može biti Demirović, ali i bilo ko drugi.
Asked who could score a goal, he answered that it could be Demirović, but also anyone else.

title: Tusk se našalio na račun Orbana zbog novca u šumi
Tusk jokes at Orbán's expense over money in the forest
body: Poljski premijer Donald Tusk ismijao je bivšeg mađarskog premijera Viktora Orbana na mreži X.
Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk mocked former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán on the X network.
Povod su dva slučaja koji su povezani s ljudima bliskim Orbanu.
The reason is two cases connected to people close to Orbán.
Tusk je napisao da se uvijek divio Orbanovoj kreativnosti, ali da je sada impresioniran kao nikad prije.
Tusk wrote that he had always admired Orbán's creativity, but that he is now impressed as never before.
Orbanov mlađi brat Áron uhapšen je 9. novembra u istrazi o vizama za građane Vijetnama.
Orbán's younger brother Áron was arrested on 9 November in an investigation into visas for citizens of Vietnam.
Viktor Orban je rekao da je on prava meta, a da je brat samo pijun.
Viktor Orbán said that he is the real target, and that his brother is only a pawn.
Istraga se vodi i protiv Miklósa Seszták, koji je bio ministar od 2014. do 2018. godine.
An investigation is also being conducted against Miklós Seszták, who was a minister from 2014 to 2018.
Mađarski istražitelji su 12. i 13. novembra pronašli novac zakopan u šumama i skriven u zgradama.
Hungarian investigators found money buried in forests and hidden in buildings on 12 and 13 November.
Premijer Péter Magyar procijenio je da se radi o više od 6 milijardi forinti.
Prime Minister Péter Magyar estimated that it is more than 6 billion forints.
Tusk se već ranije više puta šalio na račun Orbana.
Tusk has joked at Orbán's expense several times before.
Nakon Orbanovog poraza na izborima 12. aprila napisao je "Ponovo zajedno!".
After Orbán's defeat in the elections on 12 April he wrote "Together again!".
Orban je ranije rekao da ga Tusk mrzi.
Orbán said earlier that Tusk hates him.

title: Hiljade navijača BiH u Stockholmu pred utakmicu sa Švedskom
Thousands of BiH fans in Stockholm before the match against Sweden
body: Nogometna reprezentacija Bosne i Hercegovine večeras igra protiv Švedske u Ligi nacija.
The national football team of Bosnia and Herzegovina plays against Sweden tonight in the Nations League.
Utakmica počinje u 20:45 u Solni, gradu pored Stockholma.
The match starts at 20:45 in Solna, a town next to Stockholm.
Obje ekipe igraju za prvo mjesto u grupi, zato je meč vrlo važan.
Both teams are playing for first place in the group, so the match is very important.
Novinari Klixa javljaju da su bh. navijači već danas preplavili ulice Stockholma.
Klix reporters say that BiH fans already flooded the streets of Stockholm today.
Na ulicama se čuju bosanski jezik i bosanske pjesme.
Bosnian language and Bosnian songs can be heard in the streets.
Svih 52.000 ulaznica je prodano, a Ambasada BiH u Švedskoj očekuje do 40.000 navijača iz BiH i dijaspore.
All 52,000 tickets have been sold, and the BiH Embassy in Sweden expects up to 40,000 fans from BiH and the diaspora.
Ambasada je za njih otvorila i posebnu telefonsku liniju.
The embassy has also opened a special phone line for them.
Nogometni savez BiH ipak je osigurao dodatne ulaznice za navijače.
The Football Association of BiH has nevertheless secured extra tickets for the fans.
One se prodaju od 15:00 u Solna Parku, a koštaju 30 ili 60 eura.
They are on sale from 15:00 at Solna Park, and they cost 30 or 60 euros.
Mediji navijače često zovu dvanaestim igračem reprezentacije.
The media often call the fans the team's twelfth player.
Utakmicu uživo prenosi BHT.
BHT is broadcasting the match live.

title: Kiša meteora Leonidi najjača u noći na srijedu
Leonid meteor shower strongest on the night to Wednesday
body: Kiša meteora Leonidi bit će najjača u noći s utorka na srijedu, od 17. na 18. novembra.
The Leonid meteor shower will be strongest on the night from Tuesday to Wednesday, 17 to 18 November.
Pod tamnim nebom moglo bi se vidjeti 10 do 15 meteora na sat.
Under a dark sky 10 to 15 meteors per hour could be seen.
Najbolje vrijeme za gledanje je nakon ponoći, oko 00:45 po našem vremenu.
The best time for watching is after midnight, around 00:45 our time.
Leonidi su aktivni od 6. do 30. novembra, pa se pojedini meteori vide i drugih noći.
The Leonids are active from 6 to 30 November, so some meteors can be seen on other nights too.
Oni su ostaci komete 55P/Tempel-Tuttle, koja oko Sunca obiđe svake 33 godine.
They are the remains of the comet 55P/Tempel-Tuttle, which goes around the Sun every 33 years.
Prema NASA-i, u atmosferu ulaze brzinom od oko 71 kilometar u sekundi.
According to NASA, they enter the atmosphere at a speed of about 71 kilometres per second.
Zato su često vrlo svijetli, a ponekad se vide i veliki bljeskovi koji traju duže.
That is why they are often very bright, and sometimes big flashes that last longer can also be seen.
Meteori dolaze iz pravca sazviježđa Lav, ali se mogu pojaviti bilo gdje na nebu.
The meteors come from the direction of the constellation Leo, but they can appear anywhere in the sky.
Stručnjaci savjetuju da odete daleko od gradskih svjetala, na mjesto bez zgrada i drveća.
Experts advise you to go far from city lights, to a place without buildings and trees.
Dvogled i teleskop nisu potrebni, jer smanjuju dio neba koji vidite.
Binoculars and a telescope are not needed, because they reduce the part of the sky that you see.
Očima treba oko 30 minuta da se naviknu na mrak, zato tada ne gledajte u telefon.
The eyes need about 30 minutes to get used to the dark, so do not look at your phone during that time.

title: Prvi azijski Eurosong danas u Bangkoku
The first Asian Eurovision today in Bangkok
body: Prvo finale azijskog Eurosonga održava se danas u Bangkoku, glavnom gradu Tajlanda.
The first final of the Asian Eurovision is being held today in Bangkok, the capital of Thailand.
Program počinje u 14:30 po našem vremenu, a nastupa 11 zemalja.
The show starts at 14:30 our time, and 11 countries are performing.
Eurosong ove godine slavi 70. rođendan i prvi put se održava izvan Evrope.
Eurovision celebrates its 70th birthday this year and is being held outside Europe for the first time.
Pored Tajlanda, nastupaju i Malezija, Filipini, Vijetnam, Južna Koreja i Mongolija.
Besides Thailand, Malaysia, the Philippines, Vietnam, South Korea and Mongolia are also performing.
Tu su i Kambodža, Laos, Bangladeš, Nepal i Butan, ali nema Indije, Kine i Japana.
Cambodia, Laos, Bangladesh, Nepal and Bhutan are there too, but India, China and Japan are not.
Pobjednika biraju publika i žiri, svaki s 50 posto glasova.
The winner is chosen by the audience and the jury, each with 50 percent of the votes.
Tri sedmice prije finala budžet je iznenada smanjen za milion dolara.
Three weeks before the final the budget was suddenly cut by a million dollars.
Zbog toga neki tehničari nisu došli, a fanovi su kritikovali zvuk i svjetlo na probama.
Because of that some technicians did not come, and fans criticised the sound and light at rehearsals.
Favorit je Malezija, čija pjevačica Aina Abdul pjeva pjesmu inspirisanu svojom mačkom.
The favourite is Malaysia, whose singer Aina Abdul sings a song inspired by her cat.
Najmlađa učesnica je Filipinka Carmelle Collado, koja ima 19 godina.
The youngest participant is Carmelle Collado from the Philippines, who is 19 years old.
Organizatori se nadaju da bi takmičenje moglo rasti u regiji gdje živi pola svjetske populacije.
The organisers hope the contest could grow in a region where half of the world's population lives.

title: Zašto nije dobro dugo trpjeti potrebu za toaletom
Why it is not good to hold off going to the toilet for long
body: Ako ponekad dugo izdržite bez odlaska u toalet, to obično nije opasno.
If you sometimes go a long time without going to the toilet, that is usually not dangerous.
Ali urolozi upozoravaju da redovno zadržavanje mokraće može oslabiti mjehur.
But urologists warn that regularly holding urine can weaken the bladder.
Tako raste rizik od infekcije, a u težim slučajevima mogu stradati i bubrezi.
That raises the risk of infection, and in more serious cases the kidneys can also be damaged.
Prema profesoru Jasonu Kimu, zdrav mjehur može primiti oko 400 do 600 ml.
According to professor Jason Kim, a healthy bladder can hold about 400 to 600 ml.
Kada je napola pun, mozak dobija signal da je vrijeme za toalet.
When it is half full, the brain gets a signal that it is time for the toilet.
Mokraća koja dugo stoji u mjehuru postaje dobro mjesto za razvoj bakterija.
Urine that stays in the bladder for a long time becomes a good place for bacteria to grow.
Ako stalno ignorišemo potrebu, signal može postati slabiji, što Kim često vidi kod medicinskih sestara i nastavnika.
If we keep ignoring the need, the signal can become weaker, which Kim often sees in nurses and teachers.
Doktorica Giulia Ippolito savjetuje da se mjehur prazni svaka 3 do 4 sata tokom dana.
Doctor Giulia Ippolito advises emptying the bladder every 3 to 4 hours during the day.
Posebno trebaju paziti starije osobe, trudnice i ljudi s bolestima bubrega.
Older people, pregnant women and people with kidney diseases need to be especially careful.
Ako ne možete mokriti, ljekari kažu da ne treba čekati, nego otići ljekaru.
If you cannot urinate, doctors say you should not wait, but go to a doctor.
Previše čest odlazak u toalet također može biti znak dijabetesa ili infekcije.
Going to the toilet too often can also be a sign of diabetes or an infection.

title: Njemačka pobijedila Srbiju 3:1, srpski mediji vrlo kritični
Germany beat Serbia 3-1, Serbian media very critical
body: Nogometna reprezentacija Srbije izgubila je od Njemačke 3:1 u Ligi nacija.
Serbia's national football team lost 3-1 to Germany in the Nations League.
Utakmica je igrana na stadionu Marakana u Beogradu, pred skoro praznim tribinama.
The match was played at the Marakana stadium in Belgrade, in front of almost empty stands.
Bio je to peti uzastopni poraz Srbije, koja u grupi još nema nijedan bod.
It was Serbia's fifth consecutive defeat, and it still has not a single point in the group.
Njemačka je vodila već u 3. minuti, nakon autogola Srđana Babića.
Germany was leading already in the 3rd minute, after an own goal by Srđan Babić.
Florian Wirtz povećao je na 2:0, a Brajan Gruda je u 50. minuti postigao treći gol.
Florian Wirtz made it 2-0, and Brajan Gruda scored the third goal in the 50th minute.
Babić je kasnije postigao gol i za Srbiju.
Babić later scored a goal for Serbia as well.
Srbija je utakmicu završila s 9 igrača, jer su Vanja Dragojević i Andrija Živković dobili crveni karton.
Serbia finished the match with 9 players, because Vanja Dragojević and Andrija Živković got a red card.
Srpski mediji su nakon utakmice bili nemilosrdni prema timu trenera Veljka Paunovića.
After the match the Serbian media were merciless towards coach Veljko Paunović's team.
Jedan portal napisao je da je kiša potopila Beograd, a Njemačka Srbiju.
One portal wrote that the rain flooded Belgrade, and Germany flooded Serbia.
Srbija posljednju utakmicu u ovom ciklusu igra protiv Grčke 16. novembra.
Serbia plays its last match in this cycle against Greece on 16 November.

title: Snijeg i poledica na planinskim putevima u BiH
Snow and black ice on mountain roads in BiH
body: Vozači u Bosni i Hercegovini jutros voze u lošim uslovima.
Drivers in Bosnia and Herzegovina are driving in poor conditions this morning.
Na višim planinskim putevima ima snijega i poledice, a ostali putevi su mokri i klizavi.
On higher mountain roads there is snow and black ice, and the other roads are wet and slippery.
Na nekim mjestima ima i magle, javio je BIHAMK.
In some places there is also fog, BIHAMK reported.
Snijeg i poledica su na Komaru, Kupresu, Rostovu, Mliništu i na putu od Pala do Jahorine.
Snow and black ice are on Komar, Kupres, Rostovo, Mlinište and on the road from Pale to Jahorina.
Vozači ne smiju putovati bez zimske opreme, jer je ona obavezna po zakonu.
Drivers must not travel without winter equipment, because it is required by law.
Moraju prilagoditi brzinu vremenu i paziti na odrone, odnosno kamenje koje pada na cestu.
They must adapt their speed to the weather and watch out for rockfalls, that is, stones that fall onto the road.
Most Hercegovina na autoputu kod Počitelja zatvoren je zbog radova.
The Hercegovina bridge on the motorway near Počitelj is closed because of works.
Zbog radova se na mnogim putevima vozi samo jednom trakom.
Because of works, on many roads traffic uses only one lane.
Na granicama automobili čekaju najviše 30 minuta.
At the borders, cars wait at most 30 minutes.
BIHAMK upozorava da bi čekanje moglo biti duže zbog novog sistema EU za ulazak i izlazak.
BIHAMK warns that the waiting could be longer because of the new EU entry and exit system.

title: Trump, Xi i Putin sljedeće sedmice razgovaraju o oružju
Trump, Xi and Putin will talk about weapons next week
body: Bijela kuća potvrdila je da će se Donald Trump, Xi Jinping i Vladimir Putin sastati sljedeće sedmice u Kini.
The White House confirmed that Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin will meet next week in China.
Sastanak će biti u gradu Shenzhenu, tokom samita APEC-a 18. i 19. novembra.
The meeting will be in the city of Shenzhen, during the APEC summit on 18 and 19 November.
To bi bio prvi zajednički sastanak lidera SAD-a, Kine i Rusije.
It would be the first joint meeting of the leaders of the USA, China and Russia.
Trump želi razgovarati o smanjenju nuklearnog oružja u svijetu, ali i o ratu u Iranu.
Trump wants to talk about reducing nuclear weapons in the world, but also about the war in Iran.
Ukrajina neće biti tema, jer Kina nije dio tog procesa.
Ukraine will not be a topic, because China is not part of that process.
Američki zvaničnik rekao je da Washington ne očekuje dogovor, nego samo početak razgovora.
A US official said that Washington does not expect an agreement, but only the start of talks.
Ugovor New START između SAD-a i Rusije istekao je u februaru, pa prvi put nakon 50 godina nema ograničenja.
The New START treaty between the USA and Russia expired in February, so for the first time in 50 years there are no limits.
Ukrajinski predsjednik Volodimir Zelenski upozorio je da bi to mogla biti nova podjela svijeta, kao na Jalti 1945. godine.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that this could be a new division of the world, as at Yalta in 1945.
Kremlj je odbacio to poređenje, ali je sastanak nazvao izuzetno važnim.
The Kremlin rejected that comparison, but called the meeting extremely important.
Trump prije Kine putuje na Filipine, a s njim će ići i Elon Musk.
Before China, Trump is travelling to the Philippines, and Elon Musk will go with him.

title: Pitbull napunio arenu u Beogradu i pozdravio Đokovića
Pitbull filled the arena in Belgrade and greeted Đoković
body: Američki reper Pitbull održao je koncert u punoj Beogradskoj areni.
American rapper Pitbull held a concert in the full Belgrade Arena.
Nastup je dio njegove svjetske turneje pod nazivom "I'm Back".
The performance is part of his world tour called "I'm Back".
Publika ga je dočekala s velikim ovacijama.
The audience welcomed him with big ovations.
Tokom koncerta pozdravio je Novaka Đokovića i rekao da je on jedan od najboljih tenisera ikada.
During the concert he greeted Novak Đoković and said that he is one of the best tennis players ever.
Spomenuo je i košarkaša Nikolu Jokića, jednog od svojih omiljenih igrača u NBA ligi.
He also mentioned basketball player Nikola Jokić, one of his favourite players in the NBA league.
Na bini je držao bocu šljivovice, a publici je na srpskom rekao: "Hvala, Beograde".
On stage he held a bottle of plum brandy, and he told the audience in Serbian: "Thank you, Belgrade".
Pjevao je svoje velike hitove, kao što su "Give Me Everything" i "International Love".
He sang his big hits, such as "Give Me Everything" and "International Love".
Jokić voli Pitbullovu muziku, a kamere su ga 2025. snimile kako na klupi pjeva njegovu pjesmu.
Jokić loves Pitbull's music, and in 2025 cameras filmed him singing his song on the bench.
Na koncertu su bile i mnoge poznate osobe iz Srbije.
Many well-known people from Serbia were also at the concert.
Pitbull je trebao istog dana nastupiti u Bratislavi, glavnom gradu Slovačke.
Pitbull was due to perform the same day in Bratislava, the capital of Slovakia.

title: Duffy traži više novca za kontrolu letova u SAD-u
Duffy asks for more money for flight control in the USA
body: Američki zvaničnici održali su u petak konferenciju za medije u Bijeloj kući.
US officials held a press conference at the White House on Friday.
Govorili su o najvećem prekidu avionskog saobraćaja u SAD-u još od 2001. godine.
They talked about the biggest disruption of air traffic in the USA since 2001.
Ministar saobraćaja Sean Duffy potvrdio je da je zračni prostor ponovo otvoren.
Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed that the airspace has been reopened.
Duffy je rekao da je sistem kontrole letova jako star.
Duffy said that the flight control system is very old.
Ruteri su bili preopterećeni podacima, pa su podaci postali neusklađeni.
The routers were overloaded with data, so the data became inconsistent.
On je branio radove na modernizaciji sistema, iako su oni možda doprinijeli problemu.
He defended the work on modernizing the system, although it may have contributed to the problem.
Prema njegovim riječima, mnogo je veći rizik ne raditi ništa.
According to him, doing nothing is a much bigger risk.
Duffy već mjesecima traži od Kongresa dodatnih 30 milijardi dolara za modernizaciju.
For months Duffy has been asking Congress for an additional 30 billion dollars for modernization.
U petak je rekao da bi mu trebalo i 50 milijardi dolara.
On Friday he said that he would even need 50 billion dollars.
Rekao je da ne može ništa graditi ako nema novca.
He said that he cannot build anything if he has no money.
Ministar Markwayne Mullin rekao je da se slični problemi mogu očekivati i u budućnosti, jer potpuna obnova sistema traje dugo.
Secretary Markwayne Mullin said that similar problems can be expected in the future too, because a complete overhaul of the system takes a long time.

title: Argentina bez Messija izgubila od Urugvaja 2:1
Argentina without Messi lost 2-1 to Uruguay
body: Nogometna reprezentacija Argentine izgubila je od Urugvaja 2:1 na stadionu Bombonera.
Argentina's national football team lost 2-1 to Uruguay at the Bombonera stadium.
Bila je to prijateljska utakmica i prva u novoj eri bez Lionela Messija.
It was a friendly match and the first in a new era without Lionel Messi.
Argentina je igrala prvi put otkako je trener Lionel Scaloni produžio ugovor do 2030. godine.
Argentina played for the first time since coach Lionel Scaloni extended his contract until 2030.
Urugvaj, kojeg vodi Diego Forlan, do poluvremena nije imao nijedan udarac u okvir gola, ali je ipak poveo.
Uruguay, coached by Diego Forlan, had no shot on target until half-time, but still took the lead.
Lisandro Martinez je loše izbio loptu, koja je udarila saigrača Leonarda Balerdija u lice i ušla u gol.
Lisandro Martinez cleared the ball badly, and it hit teammate Leonardo Balerdi in the face and went into the goal.
Ronald Araujo je nakon kornera povećao na 2:0.
After a corner, Ronald Araujo made it 2-0.
U 72. minuti Julián Álvarez je smanjio na 2:1, nakon dodavanja Gianluce Prestiannija.
In the 72nd minute Julián Álvarez cut the lead to 2-1, after a pass from Gianluca Prestianni.
Argentina je igrala pred polupraznim tribinama i nije dobro igrala.
Argentina played in front of half-empty stands and did not play well.
Domaćim igračima nedostajala je Messijeva kreativnost, pa nisu mogli probiti odbranu Urugvaja.
The home players lacked Messi's creativity, so they could not break through Uruguay's defence.
Pred kraj je pritisak Argentine oslabio, a Urugvaj je sačuvao pobjedu.
Towards the end Argentina's pressure weakened, and Uruguay kept the win.

title: U SAD-u ponovo lete avioni nakon četiri sata blokade
Planes fly again in the USA after a four-hour blockade
body: Američka agencija za avijaciju FAA u petak je ukinula zabranu letova u cijeloj zemlji.
The US aviation agency FAA lifted the ban on flights across the whole country on Friday.
Zabrana je trajala više od 4 sata i zaustavila je hiljade letova.
The ban lasted more than 4 hours and stopped thousands of flights.
Počela je oko 16 sati po istočnom vremenu, kada su centri za kontrolu letova imali problem s komunikacijom.
It started around 16:00 Eastern Time, when the flight control centres had a communication problem.
Problemi su pogodili više od 10.000 letova.
The problems affected more than 10,000 flights.
FAA je rekla da je riječ o privremenom kvaru telekomunikacija i da je letove zaustavila iz opreza.
The FAA said that it was a temporary telecommunications fault and that it stopped the flights as a precaution.
Uzrok još nije poznat, ali ministar Markwayne Mullin rekao je da nema znakova prijetnje za SAD.
The cause is not yet known, but Secretary Markwayne Mullin said that there are no signs of a threat to the USA.
Avioni koji su već bili u zraku nastavili su let, a kompanija JetBlue otkazala je ostale letove tog dana.
Planes that were already in the air continued flying, and the company JetBlue cancelled its other flights that day.
Oko 18 sati avioni su ponovo počeli polijetati, prvo prema Evropi i Aziji.
Around 18:00 planes started taking off again, first towards Europe and Asia.
Ovakve zabrane u cijeloj zemlji su vrlo rijetke.
Bans like this across the whole country are very rare.
Prošla je bila u januaru 2023. godine, a prije toga nakon napada 11. septembra 2001.
The last one was in January 2023, and before that after the attacks of 11 September 2001.

title: Vlasnik Tindera kažnjen s 11 miliona eura
Tinder's owner fined 11 million euros
body: Irska agencija za zaštitu podataka kaznila je kompaniju Match Group s 11 miliona eura.
The Irish data protection agency fined the company Match Group 11 million euros.
Ta kompanija je vlasnik aplikacije za upoznavanje Tinder.
That company is the owner of the dating app Tinder.
Agencija je utvrdila da je Tinder prekršio evropska pravila o ličnim podacima.
The agency found that Tinder broke the European rules on personal data.
Istraga je počela u februaru 2020. godine i trajala je više od 6 godina.
The investigation started in February 2020 and lasted more than 6 years.
Agencija je provjeravala kako Tinder odgovara kada korisnici traže svoje podatke ili žele da ih aplikacija izbriše.
The agency checked how Tinder responds when users ask for their data or want the app to delete it.
Provjeravala je i koliko dugo Tinder čuva podatke korisnika.
It also checked how long Tinder keeps users' data.
Po evropskim pravilima, koja se zovu GDPR, građani EU imaju pravo na kopiju svojih podataka.
Under the European rules, which are called GDPR, EU citizens have the right to a copy of their data.
Konačna odluka donesena je 13. oktobra, a kompanija je kaznu objavila u svom izvještaju.
The final decision was made on 13 October, and the company announced the fine in its report.
Match Group je rekao da ima jaku odbranu i da će se žaliti.
Match Group said that it has a strong defence and that it will appeal.
Kazna je mala u poređenju s prihodom Tindera, koji je za 9 mjeseci zaradio 1,39 milijardi dolara.
The fine is small compared to Tinder's revenue, which earned 1.39 billion dollars in 9 months.

title: Predstava "Nestajanje" otvara Tuzlanske pozorišne dane
The play "Nestajanje" opens the Tuzla Theatre Days
body: Tuzlanski pozorišni dani počinju 18. novembra i trajat će do 1. decembra.
The Tuzla Theatre Days begin on 18 November and will last until 1 December.
Festival će otvoriti predstava "Nestajanje" Narodnog pozorišta Tuzla.
The festival will be opened by the play "Nestajanje" of the Tuzla National Theatre.
Tekst je napisao hrvatski dramski pisac Tomislav Zajec, a režiju potpisuje Milan Nešković iz Beograda.
The text was written by Croatian playwright Tomislav Zajec, and it is directed by Milan Nešković from Belgrade.
Nešković kaže da je to porodična drama o različitim oblicima zlostavljanja.
Nešković says that it is a family drama about different forms of abuse.
Predstava govori i o tome kako zlostavljanje utiče na porodicu i društvo.
The play also talks about how abuse affects the family and society.
Iako je tema teška, u predstavi ima i humora.
Although the topic is difficult, there is also humour in the play.
Glavne uloge igraju Admir Glamočak i Lamija Salihović, čija junakinja Tea ima 18 godina u prvom činu, a 40 u trećem.
The main roles are played by Admir Glamočak and Lamija Salihović, whose heroine Tea is 18 in the first act and 40 in the third.
Direktor festivala Elmir Krivalić rekao je da prvi put učestvuju sva profesionalna pozorišta iz BiH.
Festival director Elmir Krivalić said that all professional theatres from BiH are taking part for the first time.
Doći će pozorišta iz Sarajeva, Zenice, Mostara, Banje Luke i drugih gradova.
Theatres from Sarajevo, Zenica, Mostar, Banja Luka and other cities will come.
On se nada boljoj saradnji među pozorištima, a najbolji će dobiti nagrade.
He hopes for better cooperation among theatres, and the best ones will get awards.

title: Kako preskakanje večere utiče na san
How skipping dinner affects sleep
body: Mnogi ljudi preskaču večeru jer su umorni, nemaju apetit ili piju lijekove.
Many people skip dinner because they are tired, have no appetite or take medicine.
Nutricionistice Gabrielle Kishner i Samina Kalloo objašnjavaju da to može uticati na kvalitet sna.
Nutritionists Gabrielle Kishner and Samina Kalloo explain that this can affect the quality of sleep.
Za san je važno šta jedemo uveče, ali i kada jedemo.
For sleep it is important what we eat in the evening, but also when we eat.
Veliki obrok prije spavanja drži probavu aktivnom i povećava temperaturu tijela.
A big meal before sleeping keeps digestion active and raises body temperature.
Ako legnete punog stomaka, može se javiti i žgaravica.
If you lie down on a full stomach, heartburn can also appear.
S druge strane, neki ljudi ne mogu zaspati kada su gladni, a glad ih može probuditi i noću.
On the other hand, some people cannot fall asleep when they are hungry, and hunger can also wake them at night.
Kalloo je rekla da preskakanje večere može izazvati veliku glad ujutro, pa ljudi onda jedu previše.
Kalloo said that skipping dinner can cause great hunger in the morning, so people then eat too much.
Stručnjakinje savjetuju laganu užinu, na primjer jogurt s granolom ili tost s kikiriki puterom i bananom.
The experts advise a light snack, for example yogurt with granola or toast with peanut butter and banana.
Uveče treba izbjegavati masnu hranu, šećer, alkohol i kofein.
In the evening you should avoid fatty food, sugar, alcohol and caffeine.
Nakon velike večere bolje je čekati 2 do 3 sata prije nego što legnete.
After a big dinner it is better to wait 2 to 3 hours before you lie down.

title: Bajraktarević: Imamo najbolje navijače na svijetu
Bajraktarević: We have the best fans in the world
body: Reprezentacija BiH u subotu igra protiv Švedske u Solni u Ligi nacija.
The BiH national team plays against Sweden in Solna in the Nations League on Saturday.
Dan prije utakmice novinarima su se obratili selektor Sergej Barbarez i vezni igrač Esmir Bajraktarević.
The day before the match, head coach Sergej Barbarez and midfielder Esmir Bajraktarević spoke to journalists.
Bajraktarević je rekao da je cijela ekipa potpuno fokusirana na ovu utakmicu.
Bajraktarević said that the whole team is completely focused on this match.
Novinari su ga pitali i za Edina Džeku, koji više ne igra za reprezentaciju.
Journalists also asked him about Edin Džeko, who no longer plays for the national team.
Bajraktarević je rekao da je Džeko legenda i da će ga ekipi nedostajati, ali da moraju ići dalje.
Bajraktarević said that Džeko is a legend and that the team will miss him, but that they must move on.
O Švedskoj je rekao da ima kvalitetne igrače i da je igrati u gostima drugačije nego u Zenici.
About Sweden he said that it has quality players and that playing away is different from playing in Zenica.
U Solnu dolazi veliki broj navijača iz BiH i dijaspore.
A large number of fans from BiH and the diaspora are coming to Solna.
Švedski organizatori su potvrdili da su sve karte za gostujuće navijače prodane.
Swedish organisers have confirmed that all tickets for the away fans have been sold.
Bajraktarević je rekao da im navijači daju energiju i da će to pokazati na utakmici.
Bajraktarević said that the fans give them energy and that they will show it at the match.

title: Prvi snijeg u Bosanskom Petrovcu, temperatura naglo pala
First snow in Bosanski Petrovac, temperature drops sharply
body: U petak poslijepodne u Bosanskom Petrovcu počeo je padati snijeg.
On Friday afternoon snow started to fall in Bosanski Petrovac.
Mediji iz Republike Srpske javljaju da snijeg pada i u Šipovu.
Media from Republika Srpska report that snow is also falling in Šipovo.
Prognoze su govorile da snijeg stiže tek za vikend, ali hladan zrak je došao brže.
Forecasts had said that snow would only arrive at the weekend, but the cold air came faster.
U Bihaću je temperatura od 7 do 13 sati pala sa 18 na 9 stepeni.
In Bihać the temperature fell from 18 to 9 degrees between 7 and 13 o'clock.
Snijeg je zabijelio i planinske dijelove Hrvatske, gdje bi do večeri moglo pasti 30 centimetara.
Snow has also whitened the mountain parts of Croatia, where 30 centimetres could fall by the evening.
Kamere su pokazale snijeg na autoputu A6 u Gorskom kotaru.
Cameras showed snow on the A6 motorway in Gorski kotar.
Meteorolozi očekuju da u noći na subotu u višim dijelovima Bosne pada snijeg ili susnježica.
Meteorologists expect snow or sleet to fall in the higher parts of Bosnia on the night to Saturday.
U subotu ujutro u nižim dijelovima moguća je kiša ili snijeg, a u Hercegovini kiša.
On Saturday morning rain or snow is possible in the lower parts, and rain in Herzegovina.
Jutarnja temperatura bit će od -2 do 4 stepena, a dnevna od 2 do 8, na jugu do 14 stepeni.
The morning temperature will be from -2 to 4 degrees, and the daytime one from 2 to 8, in the south up to 14 degrees.

title: Minić pozdravio program Studentske liste o RS-u
Minić welcomes Student List's programme on RS
body: Novi predsjednik Republike Srpske Savo Minić pozdravio je program Studentske liste iz Srbije.
The new president of Republika Srpska Savo Minić welcomed the programme of the Student List from Serbia.
Ta lista je krajem oktobra pobijedila na prijevremenim parlamentarnim izborima u Srbiji.
That list won the early parliamentary elections in Serbia at the end of October.
Minić je na mreži X napisao da toplo pozdravlja njihovu podršku Republici Srpskoj.
Minić wrote on the X network that he warmly welcomes their support for Republika Srpska.
U programu piše da će se lista zalagati za ustavni položaj i nadležnosti RS-a.
The programme says that the list will advocate for the constitutional position and powers of RS.
Lista želi zaštititi i imovinu RS-a te pravo veta u institucijama BiH.
The list also wants to protect the property of RS and the right of veto in BiH institutions.
Također traži da se ponovo razmotri kako visoki predstavnik koristi bonska ovlaštenja.
It also asks that the way the High Representative uses the Bonn powers be reviewed again.
Visokog predstavnika bi, prema programu, trebalo birati uz odobrenje Vijeća sigurnosti UN-a.
According to the programme, the High Representative should be chosen with the approval of the UN Security Council.
Minić je rekao da će to ojačati saradnju i bratske veze između Srbije i RS-a.
Minić said that this will strengthen cooperation and brotherly ties between Serbia and RS.
Pohvalio je i plan za bliže veze sa Srbima u Hrvatskoj i Crnoj Gori.
He also praised the plan for closer ties with Serbs in Croatia and Montenegro.
Napisao je da je Srbija najjači oslonac srpskom narodu.
He wrote that Serbia is the strongest support for the Serb people.

title: Jašarević ostaje u pritvoru do 27. decembra
Jašarević stays in custody until 27 December
body: Mevlid Jašarević i dalje je u pritvoru u Vojkovićima, a pritvor mu je u petak produžen do 27. decembra.
Mevlid Jašarević is still in custody in Vojkovići, and on Friday his custody was extended until 27 December.
Sjedinjene Američke Države traže da im ga Bosna i Hercegovina izruči.
The United States of America is asking Bosnia and Herzegovina to hand him over.
To je potvrdio Siniša Perković, direktor ustanove za izvršenje krivičnih sankcija.
This was confirmed by Siniša Perković, the director of the institution for the execution of criminal sanctions.
Jašarević je 28. oktobra 2011. ispalio više od 100 metaka na zgradu američke ambasade u Sarajevu.
On 28 October 2011 Jašarević fired more than 100 bullets at the building of the American embassy in Sarajevo.
Tada je teško ranio policajca Mirsada Velića, koji je čuvao zgradu.
At that time he seriously wounded police officer Mirsad Velić, who was guarding the building.
Za terorizam je 2013. osuđen na 15 godina zatvora.
In 2013 he was sentenced to 15 years in prison for terrorism.
Trebao je izaći 27. oktobra, ali je sud tada odredio pritvor od 18 dana.
He was supposed to come out on 27 October, but the court then ordered 18 days of custody.
U Washingtonu je još 2012. podignuta optužnica protiv njega, između ostalog za pokušaj ubistva.
Back in 2012 an indictment was filed against him in Washington, among other things for attempted murder.
Njegova advokatica je rekla da se napad desio u BiH i da mu zato treba suditi ovdje.
His lawyer said that the attack happened in BiH and that he should therefore be tried here.
Jašarević je tražio da ga puste na mjesec ili dva kako bi bio sa sinom od 16 godina.
Jašarević asked to be released for a month or two so that he could be with his 16-year-old son.
On je državljanin Srbije i nema državljanstvo BiH.
He is a citizen of Serbia and does not have BiH citizenship.

title: Hrvatski influenser progovorio o smrti svoje majke
Croatian influencer speaks about his mother's death
body: Hrvatski influenser Marco Cuccurin prvi put je javno govorio o smrti svoje majke Sanje.
Croatian influencer Marco Cuccurin spoke publicly for the first time about the death of his mother Sanja.
Ona je 2021. bila pacijentica na Klinici za psihijatriju Sveti Ivan u Zagrebu.
In 2021 she was a patient at the Sveti Ivan Psychiatric Clinic in Zagreb.
Kasnije je umrla na odjelu za zarazne bolesti, a porodica je ostala s mnogo pitanja.
She later died on the infectious diseases ward, and the family was left with many questions.
Cuccurin je na Instagramu objavio video u kojem mu traka s natpisom "Dosta je" pokriva usta.
Cuccurin posted a video on Instagram in which a tape with the words "Enough" covers his mouth.
Rekao je da je majku izgubio s 20 godina i da tada nije imao snage govoriti.
He said that he lost his mother at 20 and that he did not have the strength to talk then.
Sada se osjeća obaveznim da progovori, a radnicima klinike to nikada neće oprostiti.
Now he feels obliged to speak out, and he will never forgive the clinic's workers for it.
Na istoj klinici je 21. oktobra umro bivši sportista Kristian Josip Periš.
The former athlete Kristian Josip Periš died at the same clinic on 21 October.
Četiri medicinska tehničara su u pritvoru, a direktorica klinike je podnijela ostavku.
Four medical technicians are in custody, and the clinic's director has resigned.
Cuccurin poziva građane da se u subotu u 12 sati okupe na Cvjetnom trgu u Zagrebu.
Cuccurin is calling on citizens to gather at Cvjetni trg in Zagreb on Saturday at 12 o'clock.
Tamo će osam minuta šutjeti u čast Periša, njegove majke i svih psihički oboljelih.
There they will be silent for eight minutes in honour of Periš, his mother and all the mentally ill.

title: Poslanik SDS-a prešao u Ujedinjenu Srpsku
SDS deputy switches to United Srpska
body: Vladimir Ćopić je mandat u Narodnoj skupštini RS-a osvojio na listi SDS-a, ali je sada prešao u drugu stranku.
Vladimir Ćopić won his seat in the National Assembly of RS on the SDS list, but he has now switched to another party.
U petak je predao zahtjev da uđe u klub poslanika Ujedinjene Srpske, koju vodi Nenad Stevandić.
On Friday he submitted a request to join the club of deputies of United Srpska, which is led by Nenad Stevandić.
Klix.ba piše da je on prvi poslanik u novoj skupštini koji je promijenio stranku.
Klix.ba writes that he is the first deputy in the new assembly who has changed party.
Nakon ovog prelaska SDS će imati 9 poslanika, a Ujedinjena Srpska 6.
After this switch SDS will have 9 deputies, and United Srpska 6.
Ćopić je na izborima dobio nešto više od 1.000 glasova i tako donio SDS-u jedini mandat u svojoj izbornoj jedinici.
In the election Ćopić won just over 1,000 votes and so brought SDS its only seat in his electoral unit.
Vladajuća koalicija koju vodi SNSD ima 55 poslanika.
The ruling coalition led by SNSD has 55 deputies.
To je jedan glas manje od dvotrećinske većine, koja joj treba za četvrtog delegata u Domu naroda BiH.
That is one vote short of the two-thirds majority it needs for a fourth delegate in the House of Peoples of BiH.
Draško Stanivuković nije spomenuo Ćopića po imenu, ali je rekao da je poslaniku ponuđen posao za suprugu.
Draško Stanivuković did not mention Ćopić by name, but he said that the deputy had been offered a job for his wife.
Njegov pokret će takve ponude prijaviti tužilaštvu.
His movement will report such offers to the prosecutor's office.
Milorad Dodik tvrdi da vlast već ima sigurnu dvotrećinsku većinu, a priča se i o novim prelascima.
Milorad Dodik claims that the government already has a secure two-thirds majority, and there is also talk of new switches.
Nova skupština bi se trebala konstituisati 16. novembra.
The new assembly is due to be constituted on 16 November.

title: Turskim reperima prijeti zatvor zbog pjesme "Kahpe"
Turkish rappers face prison over the song "Kahpe"
body: Turski reperi Lvbel C5 i Alizade te kompozitor Can Akdogan moraju pred sud zbog pjesme "Kahpe".
Turkish rappers Lvbel C5 and Alizade and composer Can Akdogan must go to court over the song "Kahpe".
Tužilaštvo ih optužuje da javno potiču na krivična djela.
The prosecution accuses them of publicly inciting criminal acts.
Ako ih sud proglasi krivim, prijeti im do pet godina zatvora.
If the court finds them guilty, they face up to five years in prison.
Istraga je počela nakon što se više građana žalilo predsjedničkom centru za komunikaciju.
The investigation started after several citizens complained to the presidential communication centre.
Sporni su stihovi pjesme i scene iz spota u kojima četiri osobe tuku čovjeka na podu.
The disputed parts are the lyrics of the song and scenes from the video in which four people beat a man on the floor.
Tužilaštvo kaže da pjesmu slušaju mladi i da bi mogla ugroziti javnu sigurnost.
The prosecution says that young people listen to the song and that it could threaten public safety.
Lvbel C5 je na sudu rekao da su stihovi samo mašta i da nije želio poticati nasilje.
Lvbel C5 said in court that the lyrics are only imagination and that he did not want to incite violence.
Akdogan tvrdi da nije znao šta sporni stihovi znače.
Akdogan claims that he did not know what the disputed lyrics mean.
Alizade je izvan Turske, pa je njen advokat poslao pisanu izjavu.
Alizade is outside Turkey, so her lawyer sent a written statement.
Lvbel C5 ranije nije smio napustiti zemlju, a morao je i pohađati časove turske književnosti.
Earlier Lvbel C5 was not allowed to leave the country, and he also had to attend Turkish literature classes.

title: Neredovan san povezan s depresijom i anksioznošću
Irregular sleep linked to depression and anxiety
body: Ljudi koji svaki dan liježu i ustaju u drugo vrijeme češće imaju simptome depresije i anksioznosti.
People who go to bed and get up at a different time every day more often have symptoms of depression and anxiety.
To pokazuje novo istraživanje naučnika iz Kalifornije, objavljeno u časopisu Scientific Reports.
This is shown by a new study by scientists from California, published in the journal Scientific Reports.
Takvi ljudi se također češće osjećaju usamljeno.
Such people also feel lonely more often.
Naučnici su koristili podatke oko 23.000 odraslih koji su nosili pametni prsten Oura.
The scientists used data from about 23,000 adults who wore the Oura smart ring.
Za svaku osobu su izračunali koliko je san redovan, na skali od 0 do 100.
For each person they calculated how regular their sleep is, on a scale from 0 to 100.
Ljudi bez simptoma imali su u prosjeku 84, a oni s teškom depresijom 75.
People without symptoms had an average of 84, and those with severe depression 75.
Kod teške anksioznosti prosjek je bio 79.
With severe anxiety the average was 79.
Glavna autorica Ashley Mason kaže da ne treba svima osam sati sna, ali da je redovan raspored vjerovatno važniji.
Lead author Ashley Mason says that not everyone needs eight hours of sleep, but that a regular schedule is probably more important.
Neredovan san uporedila je s jet lagom bez putovanja.
She compared irregular sleep to jet lag without travelling.
Autori upozoravaju da veza ide u oba smjera, jer depresija i anksioznost također otežavaju redovan san.
The authors warn that the link goes both ways, because depression and anxiety also make regular sleep harder.

title: Kineski robot u hotelu sam pere veš
Chinese robot in a hotel does the laundry by itself
body: Kineska kompanija ACE Robotics predstavila je robota koji u hotelu sam brine o vešu.
Chinese company ACE Robotics has presented a robot that takes care of the laundry in a hotel by itself.
Robot iz soba skuplja korpe s vešom i nosi ih u vešeraj.
The robot collects baskets of laundry from the rooms and takes them to the laundry room.
Tamo koristi mašine za pranje i sušenje, a zatim vraća čistu odjeću u sobe.
There it uses the washing and drying machines, and then it returns the clean clothes to the rooms.
Sistem se zove Mundo i napravljen je sa univerzitetom iz Singapura.
The system is called Mundo and was made with a university from Singapore.
Od fotografija pravi digitalne kopije soba i hodnika, pa robot može vježbati prije pravog posla.
It makes digital copies of rooms and corridors from photos, so the robot can practise before the real work.
Kompanija je napravila 165 pokušaja u 57 sati, samo za vađenje veša iz sušilice.
The company made 165 attempts in 57 hours, only for taking laundry out of the dryer.
Udio farmerki koje su ostale u sušilici pao je sa 48 na 32 posto.
The share of jeans that stayed in the dryer fell from 48 to 32 percent.
Kada nešto krene loše, sistem pregleda snimke kamera i promijeni pokret robota.
When something goes wrong, the system checks the camera footage and changes the robot's movement.
Kompanija kaže da bi se ova tehnologija mogla koristiti i u trgovini.
The company says that this technology could also be used in retail.
Ipak, sve brojke dolaze od kompanije i niko ih nije nezavisno provjerio.
However, all the figures come from the company and nobody has checked them independently.

title: Džeko priznao da je slavom dobio sto u restoranu
Džeko admitted he got a restaurant table thanks to his fame
body: Edin Džeko, napadač Schalkea, učestvovao je u zabavnom izazovu Bundeslige na društvenim mrežama.
Edin Džeko, Schalke's striker, took part in a fun Bundesliga challenge on social media.
Izazov se zove crveno svjetlo, zeleno svjetlo.
The challenge is called red light, green light.
Za svaku naviku igrač bira crveno ako je ne voli, a zeleno ako je odobrava.
For each habit, the player chooses red if he does not like it, and green if he approves of it.
Džeko ne voli kada igrač ima dres uvučen u šorc.
Džeko does not like it when a player has his jersey tucked into his shorts.
Crveno je dao i igračima koji nakon utakmice odu iz svlačionice bez tuširanja.
He also gave red to players who leave the dressing room after a match without showering.
S druge strane, nema ništa protiv slavlja ispred navijača protivnika.
On the other hand, he has nothing against celebrating in front of the opponent's fans.
Također mu ne smeta kada igrači kopiraju tuđe proslave golova.
He also does not mind when players copy other people's goal celebrations.
Najzanimljivije pitanje bilo je da li je koristio slavu da dobije sto u restoranu.
The most interesting question was whether he used his fame to get a table in a restaurant.
Džeko je rekao da to ne voli, ali da je to ipak ponekad radio.
Džeko said that he does not like it, but that he still sometimes did it.
Video je objavila Bundesliga na svojim društvenim mrežama.
The video was posted by the Bundesliga on its social media.

title: Čović najavio dolazak mlađih ljudi u vodstvo HDZ-a
Čović announced younger people coming into HDZ's leadership
body: Dragan Čović, predsjednik HDZ-a BiH, govorio je u petak novinarima u Mostaru.
Dragan Čović, president of HDZ BiH, spoke to journalists in Mostar on Friday.
To je bilo nakon sjednice Predsjedništva stranke.
That was after a session of the party's Presidency.
Najavio je da će u HDZ-u doći do smjene generacija.
He announced that there will be a generational change in HDZ.
Čović je rekao da je ta promjena počela s hrvatskom članicom Predsjedništva BiH.
Čović said that this change began with the Croatian member of the Presidency of BiH.
Mlađi ljudi bi trebali doći na sve nivoe vlasti.
Younger people should come to all levels of government.
Novo vodstvo stranke bit će izabrano na Saboru HDZ-a, koji se očekuje za 7 mjeseci.
The party's new leadership will be elected at the HDZ Assembly, which is expected in 7 months.
Na pitanje hoće li se opet kandidovati za predsjednika, rekao je da je njegov stav poznat.
Asked whether he will run for president again, he said that his position is known.
Govorio je i o razgovorima o novoj vlasti nakon izbora, koje vodi s predstavnicima sva tri naroda.
He also spoke about talks on the new government after the elections, which he is holding with representatives of all three peoples.
Čović je rekao da bi Hrvatska i premijer Andrej Plenković mogli pomoći BiH na putu prema EU.
Čović said that Croatia and Prime Minister Andrej Plenković could help BiH on the road towards the EU.
Prema njegovim riječima, Crna Gora će do kraja godine ispuniti sve uslove za EU.
According to him, Montenegro will meet all the conditions for the EU by the end of the year.
Dodao je da je BiH prije 15 do 20 godina bila ispred Crne Gore.
He added that 15 to 20 years ago BiH was ahead of Montenegro.

title: Do 40.000 navijača BiH očekuje se u Stockholmu
Up to 40,000 BiH fans are expected in Stockholm
body: Navijači Bosne i Hercegovine ovih dana dolaze u Stockholm iz cijelog svijeta.
Fans of Bosnia and Herzegovina are arriving in Stockholm these days from all over the world.
Reprezentacija BiH u subotu igra protiv Švedske na stadionu u Solni, pored Stockholma.
The BiH national team plays against Sweden on Saturday at the stadium in Solna, next to Stockholm.
Novinari Klixa razgovarali su s navijačima prije utakmice.
Klix journalists talked to fans before the match.
Očekuje se da će na utakmicu doći do 40.000 navijača BiH.
It is expected that up to 40,000 BiH fans will come to the match.
Neki su stigli iz Podgorice, a neki čak iz Sjedinjenih Američkih Država.
Some arrived from Podgorica, and some even from the United States of America.
Mnogi dolaze iz drugih evropskih zemalja i iz cijele Švedske, gdje živi velika bh. dijaspora.
Many are coming from other European countries and from all over Sweden, where a large Bosnian diaspora lives.
Švedske vlasti su potvrdile da su sve karte za gostujući sektor prodane.
The Swedish authorities confirmed that all the tickets for the away section have been sold.
Navijači su dobro raspoloženi i vjeruju da će Zmajevi pobijediti.
The fans are in a good mood and believe that the Dragons will win.
Zbog velikog broja ljudi, Ambasada BiH u Švedskoj otvorila je posebnu telefonsku liniju za građane.
Because of the large number of people, the BiH Embassy in Sweden opened a special phone line for citizens.
Tako navijači mogu brzo dobiti pomoć ako im zatreba.
That way fans can get help quickly if they need it.

title: Stanivuković tvrdi da vlast u RS-u kupuje opozicione poslanike
Stanivuković claims the government in RS is buying opposition MPs
body: Draško Stanivuković, predsjednik Pokreta Sigurna Srpska, održao je u petak konferenciju za medije.
Draško Stanivuković, president of the Sigurna Srpska Movement, held a press conference on Friday.
On tvrdi da vladajuća koalicija oko SNSD-a pokušava pridobiti poslanike opozicije.
He claims that the ruling coalition around SNSD is trying to win over opposition MPs.
Zbog toga će podnijeti krivične prijave za zloupotrebu položaja i trgovinu uticajem.
Because of that, he will file criminal complaints for abuse of office and trading in influence.
Prema njegovim riječima, koalicija provjerava bankovne račune poslanika i traži one koji imaju kredite.
According to him, the coalition checks MPs' bank accounts and looks for those who have loans.
Tim ljudima nude da im otplate kredit, a nekima nude i posao ili mjesto zamjenika.
They offer those people to pay off their loan, and they offer some of them a job or a deputy post.
Stanivuković je rekao da su nekima ponudili čak i nove fasade na kućama.
Stanivuković said that some were even offered new facades on their houses.
Na konferenciji je pokazao plakat s rokom do 16. decembra.
At the conference he showed a poster with a deadline of 16 December.
Najavio je da će sljedeće sedmice podnijeti još prijava.
He announced that he will file more complaints next week.
Nebojša Vukanović je 9. novembra pokazao papir za koji kaže da mu ga je dao Milorad Dodik.
On 9 November Nebojša Vukanović showed a piece of paper which he says Milorad Dodik gave him.
Na papiru je pisalo da bi tri poslanika PSS-a mogla prijeći u SNSD.
The paper said that three PSS MPs could move to SNSD.
Dodik je odbacio te priče i rekao da Stanivuković treba ići u tužilaštvo ako nešto zna.
Dodik rejected those stories and said that Stanivuković should go to the prosecutor's office if he knows something.

title: Navijači BiH pjevali „Ljiljane“ u avionu za Stockholm
BiH fans sang "Ljiljani" on the plane to Stockholm
body: Putnici na letu iz Minhena za Stockholm zajedno su pjevali pjesmu „Ljiljani“ Halida Bešlića.
Passengers on the flight from Munich to Stockholm sang the song "Ljiljani" by Halid Bešlić together.
Ta pjesma je u posljednje vrijeme postala neslužbena himna reprezentacije BiH.
That song has recently become an unofficial anthem of the BiH national team.
Kratak snimak iz aviona objavila je Sabrina Tabaković, supruga reprezentativca Harisa Tabakovića.
A short video from the plane was posted by Sabrina Tabaković, the wife of national team player Haris Tabaković.
Na snimku se vidi kako putnici podižu ruke i pjevaju.
The video shows passengers raising their hands and singing.
Ona je na Instagramu podijelila i fotografije s aerodroma u Minhenu.
On Instagram she also shared photos from the airport in Munich.
Navijači su i na aerodromu u Banjoj Luci jutros pjevali istu pjesmu prije leta.
Fans also sang the same song at the airport in Banja Luka this morning before the flight.
Zmajevi su iz Sarajeva poletjeli u 11:00.
The Dragons took off from Sarajevo at 11:00.
Švedska i BiH igraju u subotu u 20:45 u Solni, u Ligi nacija.
Sweden and BiH play on Saturday at 20:45 in Solna, in the Nations League.
Švedska je prva u grupi s 10 bodova, a BiH je druga s 8 bodova.
Sweden is first in the group with 10 points, and BiH is second with 8 points.
Ako pobijedi, BiH bi prije posljednjeg kola bila prva i mogla bi ući u Ligu A.
If it wins, BiH would be first before the last round and could get into League A.

title: Bild: Rusija traži da Finska napusti NATO
Bild: Russia asks for Finland to leave NATO
body: Njemački list Bild piše da je Rusija u Abu Dhabiju iznijela velike zahtjeve.
The German newspaper Bild writes that Russia made big demands in Abu Dhabi.
Tamo su se održali pregovori o kraju rata u Ukrajini.
Talks about ending the war in Ukraine took place there.
Prema Bildu, Rusija želi da se Finska vrati na status prije ulaska u NATO.
According to Bild, Russia wants Finland to return to its status before joining NATO.
Finska je ušla u NATO 2023. godine, nakon što je Rusija napala Ukrajinu.
Finland joined NATO in 2023, after Russia attacked Ukraine.
Rusija također traži da u Estoniji, Latviji i Litvaniji ne bude vojnih baza NATO-a.
Russia also asks that there be no NATO military bases in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.
Ukrajina bi trebala predati cijeli Donbas i ostati neutralna, bez članstva u NATO-u.
Ukraine would have to hand over the whole of Donbas and remain neutral, without NATO membership.
Zauzvrat bi Rusija povukla nuklearno oružje iz Bjelorusije.
In return, Russia would withdraw nuclear weapons from Belarus.
Bild piše da plan dolazi iz kruga oko Vladimira Putina, ali to je samo jedan od nekoliko neslužbenih prijedloga.
Bild writes that the plan comes from the circle around Vladimir Putin, but it is only one of several unofficial proposals.
Nije jasno da li je Putin odobrio ovu verziju.
It is not clear whether Putin approved this version.
Dvodnevni pregovori nisu donijeli velik napredak, ali dvije strane su se dogovorile o novoj razmjeni zarobljenika.
The two-day talks did not bring great progress, but the two sides agreed on a new prisoner exchange.

title: Izbjeglica iz BiH snimila tajni dokumentarac o danskom podzemlju
A refugee from BiH filmed a secret documentary about the Danish underworld
body: Amira Smajić došla je u Dansku 1993. godine kao petogodišnja izbjeglica iz BiH.
Amira Smajić came to Denmark in 1993 as a five-year-old refugee from BiH.
Kasnije je studirala pravo u Odenseu i postala pravnica.
Later she studied law in Odense and became a lawyer.
Više od deset godina savjetovala je kriminalne grupe kako da izbjegnu porez i operu novac.
For more than ten years she advised criminal groups on how to avoid tax and launder money.
Ona je glavna osoba dokumentarne serije „Crni labud“ danske televizije TV 2.
She is the main person of the documentary series "Black Swan" by Danish television TV 2.
Prvih 5 epizoda prikazano je u maju 2024. godine, nakon što je sud dozvolio emitovanje.
The first 5 episodes were shown in May 2024, after a court allowed the broadcast.
Smajić je tajno snimala razgovore s oko 20 ljudi, među kojima su bili advokati i bivši političari.
Smajić secretly recorded conversations with about 20 people, among them lawyers and former politicians.
Danski ministar pravde rekao je da je bio ljut i šokiran.
The Danish justice minister said that he was angry and shocked.
U junu 2025. TV 2 je objavila da je Smajić bila i doušnica policije.
In June 2025 TV 2 reported that Smajić was also a police informant.
Ona je u Danskoj više puta osuđena, između ostalog za prevaru i krivotvorenje dokumenata.
She has been convicted several times in Denmark, among other things for fraud and forging documents.
Na posljednjoj presudi dobila je i kaznu od 7,6 miliona danskih kruna, oko 2 miliona KM.
In the latest verdict she also got a fine of 7.6 million Danish kroner, about 2 million KM.

title: Olujni vjetar oborio stabla i fasade širom BiH
Storm wind knocked down trees and facades across BiH
body: Olujni vjetar je u posljednja dva dana napravio štetu u mnogim dijelovima Bosne i Hercegovine.
Storm wind caused damage in many parts of Bosnia and Herzegovina over the last two days.
Vjetar je rušio stabla i trgao dijelove fasada sa zgrada.
The wind brought down trees and tore parts of facades off buildings.
Štete je bilo u Trebinju, Bugojnu, Karauli i Kotor Varošu.
