There was damage in Trebinje, Bugojno, Karaula and Kotor Varoš.
Federalni hidrometeorološki zavod najavljuje danas uglavnom oblačno vrijeme s kišom i pljuskovima.
The Federal Hydrometeorological Institute forecasts mostly cloudy weather with rain and showers today.
Ujutro će vjetar s juga i jugozapada još biti jak, a bit će i jakih udara.
In the morning the wind from the south and southwest will still be strong, and there will also be strong gusts.
Tokom dana vjetar će slabiti i okretati se na zapadni i sjeverozapadni.
During the day the wind will weaken and turn to the west and northwest.
Na sjeveru i sjeverozapadu Bosne temperatura će biti od 6 do 12 stepeni.
In the north and northwest of Bosnia the temperature will be from 6 to 12 degrees.
U Hercegovini će biti do 20 stepeni.
In Herzegovina it will be up to 20 degrees.
Pred kraj dana i tokom noći temperatura će padati.
Towards the end of the day and during the night the temperature will fall.
Na planinama i u višim dijelovima Bosne noću se očekuje snijeg ili susnježica.
Snow or sleet is expected at night in the mountains and in higher parts of Bosnia.
Najviše padavina bit će u Hercegovini te u zapadnoj i sjeverozapadnoj Bosni.
The most precipitation will be in Herzegovina and in western and northwestern Bosnia.

title: Pakistanac će biti prvi stranac na kineskoj svemirskoj stanici
A Pakistani will be the first foreigner on the Chinese space station
body: Jedan astronaut iz Pakistana uskoro će postati prvi stranac na kineskoj svemirskoj stanici Tiangong.
An astronaut from Pakistan will soon become the first foreigner on the Chinese space station Tiangong.
To je objavila kineska agencija za letove s ljudskom posadom.
This was announced by the Chinese agency for crewed flights.
Let s misijom Shenzhou-24 očekuje se do kraja novembra.
The flight with the Shenzhou-24 mission is expected by the end of November.
Izabrana su dva pakistanska kandidata, a obojica su piloti pakistanske vojske.
Two Pakistani candidates were chosen, and both are pilots of the Pakistani army.
Jedan će letjeti, a drugi će biti rezerva.
One will fly, and the other will be the backup.
Pakistanski astronaut će na stanici izvesti 4 naučna eksperimenta, koji su izabrani između više od 300 prijedloga.
The Pakistani astronaut will carry out 4 scientific experiments at the station, which were chosen from more than 300 proposals.
Na stanici bi trebao ostati oko jednu sedmicu.
He should stay at the station for about one week.
Raketa će poletjeti iz centra Jiuquan u pustinji Gobi.
The rocket will take off from the Jiuquan centre in the Gobi Desert.
Kina i Pakistan potpisali su sporazum o ovoj misiji u februaru 2025. godine.
China and Pakistan signed the agreement on this mission in February 2025.
Kandidati su se pripremali u centru za astronaute u Pekingu.
The candidates prepared at the astronaut centre in Beijing.
Glasnogovornik kineskog ministarstva vanjskih poslova rekao je da su dvije zemlje strateški partneri.
The spokesperson of the Chinese foreign ministry said that the two countries are strategic partners.

title: Infarkt je moguć i kada je holesterol nizak
A heart attack is possible even when cholesterol is low
body: Infarkt se može dogoditi i kada je LDL, takozvani loši holesterol, pod kontrolom.
A heart attack can happen even when LDL, the so-called bad cholesterol, is under control.
Novo istraživanje iz Švedske proučilo je dvije druge vrste masnih čestica u krvi.
A new study from Sweden examined two other kinds of fatty particles in the blood.
Studiju su vodili naučnici s Univerziteta Chalmers, a objavljena je u časopisu European Heart Journal.
The study was led by scientists from Chalmers University, and it was published in the journal European Heart Journal.
Te dvije vrste čestica zovu se TRL i lipoprotein(a).
These two kinds of particles are called TRL and lipoprotein(a).
Naučnici su u krvi izmjerili skoro 3.000 proteina i uporedili ih s genetskim podacima i zdravstvenim kartonima ljudi.
The scientists measured almost 3,000 proteins in the blood and compared them with people's genetic data and medical records.
Otkrili su da obje vrste čestica imaju sličan obrazac proteina, a oba obrasca povezana su s kasnijim bolestima srca.
They found that both kinds of particles have a similar pattern of proteins, and both patterns are linked to later heart disease.
Ti proteini mogu privući imunološke ćelije i tako izazvati upalu u krvnim sudovima.
These proteins can attract immune cells and so cause inflammation in the blood vessels.
Istraživač Clemens Wittenbecher rekao je da je smanjenje LDL-a i dalje osnova prevencije.
Researcher Clemens Wittenbecher said that lowering LDL is still the basis of prevention.
Studija nije testirala novi lijek i nije donijela krvni test za svakodnevnu upotrebu.
The study did not test a new medicine and did not produce a blood test for everyday use.
Prema Svjetskoj zdravstvenoj organizaciji, od bolesti srca i krvnih sudova svake godine umre oko 17,9 miliona ljudi.
According to the World Health Organization, about 17.9 million people die from diseases of the heart and blood vessels every year.

title: Otac Due Lipe: Ratne 1992. bio sam u Sarajevu
Dua Lipa's father: In the war year 1992 I was in Sarajevo
body: Dukagjin Lipa, otac i menadžer pjevačice Due Lipe, govorio je za RTL o svom životu i poslu.
Dukagjin Lipa, father and manager of singer Dua Lipa, spoke to RTL about his life and work.
Rekao je da je 1992. sa suprugom ostao zarobljen u ratnom Sarajevu.
He said that in 1992 he and his wife were trapped in wartime Sarajevo.
U Sarajevu je proveo i veliki dio studentskih dana.
He also spent a large part of his student days in Sarajevo.
Lipa je u četvrtak bio u Zagrebu na konferenciji o festivalu Sunny Hill, koji je pokrenuo u Prištini.
On Thursday Lipa was in Zagreb at a conference about the Sunny Hill festival, which he started in Priština.
Na festivalu su do sada nastupali Miley Cyrus, Katy Perry i drugi poznati muzičari.
Miley Cyrus, Katy Perry and other famous musicians have performed at the festival so far.
Iz Prištine je 1992. zbog politike otišao u London.
In 1992 he left Priština for London because of politics.
Kaže da odluke donosi zajedno s kćerkom, ali da u kreativnim pitanjima zadnju riječ uvijek ima Dua.
He says that he makes decisions together with his daughter, but that on creative questions Dua always has the last word.
Porodica pokušava živjeti normalno, a sva tri djeteta tečno govore albanski.
The family tries to live normally, and all three children speak Albanian fluently.
On sam, kako kaže, govori hrvatski s bosanskim naglaskom.
He himself, as he says, speaks Croatian with a Bosnian accent.
Smatra da muzičari i sportisti mogu učiniti više za svoju zemlju nego političari.
He thinks that musicians and athletes can do more for their country than politicians.
Dodao je da je drago što mladi ljudi preuzimaju odgovornost.
He added that he is glad that young people are taking responsibility.

title: Pochettino je novi trener Manchester Uniteda
Pochettino is the new manager of Manchester United
body: Mauricio Pochettino bit će novi trener Manchester Uniteda, javio je novinar Fabrizio Romano.
Mauricio Pochettino will be the new manager of Manchester United, journalist Fabrizio Romano reported.
Pochettino ima 54 godine i sada vodi reprezentaciju SAD-a.
Pochettino is 54 years old and now leads the US national team.
Mijenja Michaela Carricka, kojeg je klub otpustio u četvrtak.
He replaces Michael Carrick, whom the club fired on Thursday.
Manchester United ima samo 8 bodova iz 10 utakmica i nalazi se na 18. mjestu u Premier ligi.
Manchester United has only 8 points from 10 matches and is in 18th place in the Premier League.
To je najgori početak sezone za klub u posljednjih 40 godina.
That is the club's worst start to a season in the last 40 years.
Prema ESPN-u, United mora platiti 10 miliona dolara da bi Pochettino mogao napustiti američki savez.
According to ESPN, United must pay 10 million dollars so that Pochettino can leave the American federation.
Pochettino je osmi stalni trener kluba otkako je Sir Alex Ferguson otišao 2013. godine.
Pochettino is the club's eighth permanent manager since Sir Alex Ferguson left in 2013.
Ranije je vodio Tottenham, PSG i Chelsea, a s PSG-om je 2022. osvojio prvenstvo Francuske.
Earlier he managed Tottenham, PSG and Chelsea, and with PSG he won the French league in 2022.
Reprezentaciju SAD-a vodi od septembra 2024, a ovog ljeta s njom je stigao do osmine finala Svjetskog prvenstva.
He has led the US national team since September 2024, and this summer he reached the round of 16 of the World Cup with it.
Prva velika utakmica čeka ga 22. novembra protiv Liverpoola na Anfieldu.
His first big match awaits him on 22 November against Liverpool at Anfield.

title: Kane oborio rekord Engleske u pobjedi protiv Hrvatske
Kane breaks England record in win over Croatia
body: Harry Kane je u četvrtak navečer na Wembleyju odigrao 126. utakmicu za Englesku.
On Thursday evening at Wembley, Harry Kane played his 126th match for England.
Tako je oborio rekord Petera Shiltona, koji je imao 125 nastupa od 1990. godine.
In that way he broke the record of Peter Shilton, who had had 125 appearances since 1990.
Engleska je pobijedila Hrvatsku 2:1, a Kane je postigao pobjednički gol iz penala u 64. minuti.
England beat Croatia 2–1, and Kane scored the winning goal from a penalty in the 64th minute.
Prvi gol za Englesku dao je Morgan Rogers, a za Hrvatsku je izjednačio Petar Sučić.
Morgan Rogers scored the first goal for England, and Petar Sučić equalised for Croatia.
Prije utakmice Kane je navijačima pokazao Zlatnu loptu, koju je dobio krajem oktobra.
Before the match Kane showed the fans the Ballon d'Or, which he received at the end of October.
Shilton i princ William uručili su mu nagrade, a Luka Modrić dao mu je poklon hrvatskog saveza.
Shilton and Prince William presented him with awards, and Luka Modrić gave him a gift from the Croatian federation.
Kane je za Englesku postigao 92 gola, što je također rekord.
Kane has scored 92 goals for England, which is also a record.
Kane ima 33 godine i igra za Bayern iz Münchena.
Kane is 33 years old and plays for Bayern Munich.
Rekao je da su ovo vjerovatno najveći uspjesi u njegovoj karijeri.
He said that these are probably the biggest successes of his career.
Engleska je s ovom pobjedom osigurala četvrtfinale Lige nacija u martu.
With this win England secured the Nations League quarter-final in March.
U nedjelju igra još jednu utakmicu, u gostima protiv Španije.
On Sunday it plays one more match, away against Spain.

title: Studenti u Srbiji žele prekinuti trgovinu oružjem s Izraelom
Students in Serbia want to stop the arms trade with Israel
body: Studentska lista u Srbiji najavila je da bi prekinula trgovinu oružjem s Izraelom.
The Student List in Serbia announced that it would stop the arms trade with Israel.
To je rekao Filip Ubović, student i predstavnik pokreta, u podcastu britanskog novinara Arona Bastanija.
This was said by Filip Ubović, a student and representative of the movement, on the podcast of British journalist Aron Bastani.
Pokret želi zaustaviti i projekat izraelske fabrike dronova u Srbiji.
The movement also wants to stop the project of an Israeli drone factory in Serbia.
Ubović je rekao da je ono što se tamo događa mrlja na čovječanstvu.
Ubović said that what is happening there is a stain on humanity.
Fabriku je predsjednik Aleksandar Vučić otvorio u septembru.
President Aleksandar Vučić opened the factory in September.
Izraelska kompanija Elbit Systems ima 51 posto fabrike, a srpska državna firma Yugoimport 49 posto.
The Israeli company Elbit Systems owns 51 percent of the factory, and the Serbian state firm Yugoimport 49 percent.
Prema BIRN-u, izvoz oružja iz Srbije u Izrael od 2023. porastao je 42 puta, na 114 miliona eura.
According to BIRN, arms exports from Serbia to Israel have grown 42 times since 2023, to 114 million euros.
Vučić je na Instagramu rekao da strane službe žele uništiti srpsku vojnu industriju.
Vučić said on Instagram that foreign services want to destroy the Serbian military industry.
Bivša premijerka Ana Brnabić upozorila je da bi više od 20.000 radnika moglo ostati bez posla.
Former prime minister Ana Brnabić warned that more than 20,000 workers could lose their jobs.
Nova Narodna skupština Srbije prvi put će se sastati u utorak.
The new National Assembly of Serbia will meet for the first time on Tuesday.

title: Veliki kvar: Outlook i Teams satima ne rade
Major outage: Outlook and Teams down for hours
body: Microsoft 365 usluge imaju veliki kvar od četvrtka navečer, a problemi se nastavljaju i u petak ujutro.
Microsoft 365 services have had a major outage since Thursday evening, and the problems are continuing on Friday morning.
Korisnici širom svijeta ne mogu normalno koristiti Outlook, Teams, SharePoint i Copilot.
Users around the world cannot use Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and Copilot normally.
Microsoft je rekao da problem može imati svako, u bilo kojoj regiji.
Microsoft said that anyone, in any region, could have the problem.
Kompanija je problem potvrdila u četvrtak, malo prije 19 sati po lokalnom vremenu.
The company confirmed the problem on Thursday, shortly before 19:00 local time.
Na stranici Downdetector skoro 130.000 korisnika prijavilo je probleme s Outlookom.
On the Downdetector site, almost 130,000 users reported problems with Outlook.
Prvo se govorilo o većem opterećenju, ali uzrok je bio drugi.
At first there was talk of a higher load, but the cause was something else.
Neki serveri su neočekivano prestali raditi, pa su ostali serveri bili preopterećeni.
Some servers unexpectedly stopped working, so the other servers were overloaded.
Inženjeri su promet preusmjerili na servere u drugim dijelovima svijeta i ponovo pokrenuli neispravne servere.
Engineers rerouted traffic to servers in other parts of the world and restarted the faulty servers.
Microsoft kaže da se usluge polako vraćaju, ali nije rekao kada će sve raditi.
Microsoft says that the services are slowly coming back, but it did not say when everything will work.
Kompanija ne vjeruje da je kvar izazvao hakerski napad.
The company does not believe that the outage was caused by a hacker attack.
Prema agenciji Reuters, kvar je pogodio i veze koje AI usluge OpenAI i Anthropic koriste za Microsoft 365.
According to the Reuters agency, the outage also hit the connections that the AI services OpenAI and Anthropic use for Microsoft 365.

title: Jaka kiša u Hercegovini: moguće su poplave
Heavy rain in Herzegovina: floods are possible
body: U Hercegovini se od 13. do 16. novembra očekuju vrlo jake padavine.
Very heavy rainfall is expected in Herzegovina from 13 to 16 November.
Zbog toga bi rijeke mogle porasti, a na nekim mjestima moguće su i poplave.
Because of that the rivers could rise, and in some places floods are also possible.
Za ovo područje izdato je narandžasto upozorenje.
An orange warning has been issued for this area.
Najveći rizik je u slivu Neretve, u slivu rijeka Tihaljine, Mlade i Trebižata, te na rijeci Vrioštici.
The biggest risk is in the Neretva basin, in the basin of the rivers Tihaljina, Mlade and Trebižat, and on the river Vrioštica.
Manji potoci mogli bi se izliti, a moguće su bujice i poplave u gradovima.
Smaller streams could overflow, and flash floods and floods in towns are possible.
Bujica je nagla i brza voda koja nastaje nakon jake kiše.
A flash flood is sudden, fast water that forms after heavy rain.
Očekuju se viši nivo vode i brži tok rijeka.
Higher water levels and faster river flow are expected.
Agencija za vodno područje Jadranskog mora pozvala je nadležne da prate situaciju.
The Agency for the Adriatic Sea Water Area called on the authorities to monitor the situation.
Civilna zaštita treba upozoriti stanovnike koji žive blizu rijeka da se ne približavaju obali.
Civil protection should warn residents who live near rivers not to approach the riverbank.
Ljudi bi trebali na vrijeme dobiti savjete kako smanjiti moguću štetu.
People should receive advice in time on how to reduce possible damage.
Narandžasto upozorenje zbog vjetra i kiše izdato je i za Sarajevo.
An orange warning for wind and rain has also been issued for Sarajevo.

title: FBI zaplijenio 1,2 milijarde dolara ukradenih kriptovaluta
FBI seizes 1.2 billion dollars of stolen cryptocurrency
body: Američko Ministarstvo pravde dobilo je dozvolu suda da zaplijeni ili blokira više od 1,2 milijarde dolara u kriptovalutama.
The US Department of Justice got permission from a court to seize or block more than 1.2 billion dollars in cryptocurrencies.
Novac je prošlog mjeseca ukraden s Binancea, najveće kripto berze na svijetu.
The money was stolen last month from Binance, the biggest crypto exchange in the world.
FBI kaže da iza krađe stoji sjevernokorejska hakerska grupa TraderTraitor.
The FBI says that the North Korean hacker group TraderTraitor is behind the theft.
Ukradeno je oko 6,3 milijarde dolara, pa je to najveća kripto pljačka u historiji.
About 6.3 billion dollars was stolen, so it is the biggest crypto robbery in history.
Vlada SAD-a i privatne kompanije do sada su zamrznule više od 2,7 milijardi dolara.
The US government and private companies have so far frozen more than 2.7 billion dollars.
U ovakvim slučajevima sudija na kraju odlučuje ko ima pravo na vraćeni novac.
In cases like this, a judge decides in the end who has the right to the recovered money.
Istog dana FBI je Sjevernu Koreju optužio i za drugu prevaru, koja se zove FaceStealer.
On the same day the FBI also accused North Korea of another scam, which is called FaceStealer.
Kroz nju je u posljednjih 18 mjeseci ukradeno oko 400 miliona dolara u kriptovalutama.
Through it, about 400 million dollars in cryptocurrencies has been stolen in the last 18 months.
Hakeri preuzimaju aplikacije za poruke i prave lažne video snimke, takozvane deepfake videe.
The hackers take over messaging apps and make fake video recordings, so-called deepfake videos.
Američki zvaničnici kažu da Sjeverna Koreja tim novcem finansira svoj program oružja.
American officials say that North Korea funds its weapons programme with that money.

title: SAD daju novac za istraživanje zabranjene droge ibogain
US gives money for research on the banned drug ibogaine
body: Američko ministarstvo zdravlja dat će do 4,9 miliona dolara za razvoj ibogaina kao mogućeg lijeka.
The US Department of Health will give up to 4.9 million dollars for the development of ibogaine as a possible medicine.
Ibogain je psihodelična droga koja dolazi iz afričke biljke iboga i u SAD-u je zabranjena.
Ibogaine is a psychedelic drug that comes from the African iboga plant, and it is banned in the US.
Istraživači žele vidjeti može li pomoći veteranima koji imaju PTSP, poremećaj nakon teškog stresa.
Researchers want to see whether it can help veterans who have PTSD, a disorder after severe stress.
Novac će biti podijeljen kroz pet godina preko agencije ARPA-H.
The money will be distributed over five years through the agency ARPA-H.
Istraživanje vodi farmaceutska kompanija milijardera Marka Cubana.
The research is led by the pharmaceutical company of billionaire Mark Cuban.
Kompanija Beond dat će podatke o sigurnosti, dozama i djelovanju ibogaina.
The company Beond will provide data on the safety, doses and effects of ibogaine.
Ministarstvo je najavilo i novac za istraživanje ibogaina kao lijeka za ovisnost o opioidima.
The ministry also announced money for research on ibogaine as a medicine for opioid addiction.
Ministarstvo naglašava da novac nije za liječenje pacijenata i da FDA nije odobrila lijek.
The ministry stresses that the money is not for treating patients and that the FDA has not approved the medicine.
Novac je za pripremu kliničkih ispitivanja i za proizvodnju ibogaina u SAD-u.
The money is for preparing clinical trials and for producing ibogaine in the US.
Ibogain može izazvati opasne probleme sa srčanim ritmom, pa bi pacijente trebalo pažljivo pratiti.
Ibogaine can cause dangerous problems with heart rhythm, so patients would need to be carefully monitored.

title: Fazla oduševio publiku na koncertu u Slogi
Fazla thrills the audience at a concert in Sloga
body: Pjevač i kompozitor Muhamed Fazlagić Fazla održao je koncert u sarajevskom klubu Cinemas Sloga.
Singer and composer Muhamed Fazlagić Fazla held a concert in the Sarajevo club Cinemas Sloga.
Publika ga je dočekala dugim aplauzom i pjevala je s njim njegove poznate pjesme.
The audience welcomed him with long applause and sang his well-known songs with him.
Ljudi su plesali i uživali u muzici i atmosferi.
People danced and enjoyed the music and the atmosphere.
Fazla je izveo mnoge hitove iz svoje karijere.
Fazla performed many hits from his career.
Među njima su bile pjesme "Sva bol svijeta", "Kiša ruši grad" i "Linija života".
Among them were the songs "Sva bol svijeta", "Kiša ruši grad" and "Linija života".
Na koncertu je sa suprugom bio i član Predsjedništva BiH Željko Komšić.
Member of the BiH Presidency Željko Komšić was also at the concert with his wife.
Koncert je najavio krajem oktobra novom pjesmom i spotom "Zauvijek suđeni".
He announced the concert at the end of October with a new song and music video, "Zauvijek suđeni".
Muziku je napisao sam, a tekst je napisao Admir Srabović.
He wrote the music himself, and Admir Srabović wrote the lyrics.
Početkom novembra predstavio je i novi spot za pjesmu "Linija života".
At the beginning of November he also presented a new music video for the song "Linija života".
Ta pjesma je prvi put izašla 1993. godine na njegovom prvom albumu, a sada ima novi aranžman.
That song first came out in 1993 on his first album, and now it has a new arrangement.

title: U Turskoj pao vojni helikopter, poginula četiri vojnika
Military helicopter crashes in Turkey, four soldiers killed
body: U Turskoj se u četvrtak srušio vojni helikopter, a sva četiri vojnika u njemu su poginula.
A military helicopter crashed in Turkey on Thursday, and all four soldiers on board were killed.
Nesreća se dogodila oko 18:45 po lokalnom vremenu, u selu Samankoy u provinciji Malatya.
The accident happened at around 18:45 local time, in the village of Samankoy in Malatya province.
U BiH je tada bilo 16:45.
In BiH it was 16:45 at the time.
Helikopter tipa S-70 bio je na zadatku i pripadao je jednom puku kopnene vojske.
The S-70 helicopter was on a mission and belonged to an army regiment.
Nakon pada izbio je požar, koji je zahvatio i jednu kuću u blizini.
After the crash a fire broke out, which also spread to a nearby house.
Vatrogasci su ugasili vatru, a na mjesto su stigle i hitna pomoć i turska služba za katastrofe.
Firefighters put out the fire, and ambulances and the Turkish disaster service also arrived at the scene.
Turski mediji objavili su i snimak nesreće.
Turkish media also published a video of the accident.
Tursko ministarstvo odbrane saopćilo je da uzrok nesreće još nije poznat.
The Turkish defence ministry said that the cause of the accident is not yet known.
Ministarstvo je izrazilo saučešće porodicama poginulih vojnika, ali njihova imena još nisu objavljena.
The ministry expressed condolences to the families of the killed soldiers, but their names have not yet been published.
Policija i vojska sada istražuju šta se dogodilo.
The police and the army are now investigating what happened.

title: KK Bosna zbog bazara vjerovatno igra na Grbavici
Because of a bazaar, KK Bosna will probably play at Grbavica
body: Košarkaši Bosne BH Telecom vjerovatno će jednu utakmicu ABA lige igrati izvan dvorane Zetra.
The basketball players of Bosna BH Telecom will probably play one ABA League game outside the Zetra arena.
Protiv Ilirije u 9. kolu trebali bi igrati u dvorani "Goran Čengić" na Grbavici.
They should play against Ilirija in round 9 in the "Goran Čengić" hall at Grbavica.
Razlog je Diplomatski zimski bazar, koji počinje u Zetri u subotu u 11 sati.
The reason is the Diplomatic Winter Bazaar, which starts in Zetra on Saturday at 11 o'clock.
Bosna u nedjelju u Zetri dočekuje Megu, a sljedeće sedmice igra dvije utakmice.
On Sunday, Bosna hosts Mega in Zetra, and next week it plays two games.
U srijedu, 18. novembra, igra protiv Lietkabelisa u Eurocupu.
On Wednesday, 18 November, it plays against Lietkabelis in the Eurocup.
Utakmica s Ilirijom bila je planirana za sljedeći dan, ali je pomjerena na petak, jer su dvije utakmice zaredom preteške za igrače.
The game with Ilirija was planned for the next day, but it was moved to Friday, because two games in a row are too hard for the players.
ABA liga je utakmicu zakazala za 20 sati.
The ABA League scheduled the game for 20:00.
Štandovi za bazar moraju se postaviti dan ranije, pa Zetra u petak navečer neće biti slobodna.
The stalls for the bazaar must be set up a day earlier, so Zetra will not be free on Friday evening.
Na stranici ABA lige kao mjesto utakmice već piše dvorana na Grbavici.
The ABA League website already lists the hall at Grbavica as the venue of the game.
Ipak, Klix.ba navodi da bi se mjesto još moglo promijeniti.
However, Klix.ba states that the venue could still change.

title: Tarantino otkrio da je prije snimanja otpustio dvije glumice
Tarantino reveals he fired two actresses before filming
body: Režiser Quentin Tarantino otkrio je da je prije snimanja filma "Nemilosrdni gadovi" otpustio dvije glumice.
Director Quentin Tarantino has revealed that he fired two actresses before shooting the film "Inglourious Basterds".
O tome govori u novoj knjizi Jaya Glenniea o nastanku filma.
He talks about it in a new book by Jay Glennie about the making of the film.
Film je izašao 2009. godine i zaradio je 321 milion dolara.
The film came out in 2009 and earned 321 million dollars.
Prva je bila Mélanie Laurent, koja je loše odigrala prvo čitanje scenarija.
The first was Mélanie Laurent, who performed badly at the first reading of the script.
Nekoliko dana kasnije nazvala je Tarantina i ponudila da sama plati put i hotel kako bi dobila novu priliku.
A few days later she called Tarantino and offered to pay for the trip and hotel herself to get a new chance.
Režiser je pristao, a nakon tri dana proba vratio joj je ulogu Shosanne.
The director agreed, and after three days of rehearsals he gave her back the role of Shosanna.
Isabelle Huppert nije došla na čitanje, a bilo je i problema s njenim ugovorom, pa je ulogu dobila Maggie Cheung.
Isabelle Huppert did not come to the reading, and there were also problems with her contract, so Maggie Cheung got the role.
Na kraju su sve scene s tim likom izbačene iz filma.
In the end, all scenes with that character were cut from the film.
Tarantino je rekao da glumcima ne duguje ništa, ali da filmu duguje najbolje glumce koje može naći.
Tarantino said that he owes the actors nothing, but that he owes the film the best actors he can find.
Za Laurent je dodao da je odlično odigrala ulogu.
About Laurent he added that she played the role excellently.

title: Vijeće ministara zaustavilo saradnju škola s NASA-om
Council of Ministers stops schools' cooperation with NASA
body: Vijeće ministara BiH na današnjoj sjednici nije prihvatilo prijedlog za sporazum s američkom svemirskom agencijom NASA.
At today's session, the BiH Council of Ministers did not accept the proposal for an agreement with the American space agency NASA.
Sporazum je trebalo da potpiše Ministarstvo civilnih poslova BiH.
The agreement was to be signed by the BiH Ministry of Civil Affairs.
Zbog toga škole iz BiH zasad neće službeno učestvovati u programu GLOBE.
Because of this, schools from BiH will not officially take part in the GLOBE programme for now.
GLOBE je međunarodni obrazovni i naučni program koji podržava NASA.
GLOBE is an international educational and scientific programme supported by NASA.
On povezuje škole, učenike, nastavnike i naučnike u više od 125 zemalja.
It connects schools, pupils, teachers and scientists in more than 125 countries.
Učenici u programu prate okoliš i klimatske promjene, a podatke dijele s naučnicima širom svijeta.
Pupils in the programme monitor the environment and climate change, and share data with scientists around the world.
Nastavnici dobijaju dodatnu obuku i nove metode rada.
Teachers get extra training and new working methods.
Ministarstvo je pokrenulo ovaj proces jer želi da škole iz cijele BiH uđu u mrežu.
The ministry started this process because it wants schools from all of BiH to join the network.
U članku nije navedeno zašto je Vijeće ministara odbilo prijedlog.
The article does not state why the Council of Ministers rejected the proposal.
Iz ministarstva su poručili da će nastaviti raditi kako bi škole i naučne institucije mogle ući u međunarodne programe.
The ministry said that it will continue working so that schools and scientific institutions can join international programmes.
